[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[69]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-69 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this section,

  [[in bulk]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[in bulk]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a sale of gasoline
      or diesel fuel, means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in a quantity of five hundred litres or more,
        where the gasoline or diesel fuel is delivered to the purchaser
        at a retail outlet of the vendor, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any quantity, in any other case; ([en
        vrac]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[logging]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[logging]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the felling, limbing,
      bucking and marking of trees, construction of logging roads,
      off-highway transportation of logs to a mill-pond or mill yard,
      log salvaging and reforestation, but does not include any
      production activity on logs after transportation to a mill-pond or
      mill yard; ([opérations forestières]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mineral resource]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mineral resource]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a base or precious metal deposit,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a coal deposit, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a mineral deposit in respect of which

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the Minister of Natural Resources has
          certified that the principal mineral extracted is an
          industrial mineral contained in a non-bedded deposit,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the principal mineral extracted is sylvite,
          halite or gypsum, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the principal mineral extracted is silica
          that is extracted from sandstone or quartzite; ([ressource
          minérale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mining]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mining]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the extracting of minerals
      from a mineral resource, the processing of ore, other than iron
      ore, from a mineral resource to the prime metal stage or its
      equivalent, the processing of iron ore from a mineral resource to
      the pellet stage or its equivalent and the restoration of
      strip-mined land to a usable condition, but does not include
      activities related to the exploration for or development of a
      mineral resource; ([opérations minières]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[qualified]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[qualified]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a farmer,
      fisherman, hunter, trapper or other person, means a farmer,
      fisherman, hunter, trapper or person who holds a sales tax bulk
      permit issued under regulations made pursuant to subsection
      (10); ([admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[registered vendor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[registered vendor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who is
      registered under regulations made pursuant to subsection
      (10). ([vendeur enregistré]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Fuel tax rebate to vendor

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where gasoline or diesel fuel has been sold by a
  licensed manufacturer or licensed wholesaler to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, R.S., 1985, c. 42 (2nd Supp.), s.
    9\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a qualified fisherman for commercial fishing,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a qualified hunter for commercial hunting,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a qualified trapper for commercial trapping,

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a qualified person for use in logging, or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a qualified person for use in mining,

  for the sole use of the purchaser and not for resale and the taxes
  imposed by Parts III and VI are payable in respect of the sale, the
  manufacturer or wholesaler may, in such circumstances and on such
  terms and conditions as the Minister may prescribe, deduct, within two
  years after the sale, a fuel tax rebate in an amount calculated in
  accordance with subsections (8) and (8.01) from the amount of any
  payment of any tax, penalty, interest or other sum that the
  manufacturer or wholesaler is liable or is about to become liable to
  make under those Parts or under this Part in respect of taxes under
  those Parts.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Fuel tax rebate to vendor selling to
  farmer

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} Where gasoline or diesel fuel has been sold by a
  licensed manufacturer or licensed wholesaler to a qualified farmer for
  farming purposes, for the sole use of the qualified farmer and not for
  resale and the tax imposed by Parts III and VI is payable in respect
  of the sale, the manufacturer or wholesaler may, in such circumstances
  and on such terms and conditions as the Minister may prescribe,
  deduct, within two years after the sale, a fuel tax rebate in an
  amount calculated in accordance with subsections (8.1) and (8.2) from
  the amount of any payment of any tax, penalty, interest or other sum
  that the manufacturer or wholesaler is liable or is about to become
  liable to make under those Parts or under this Part in respect of tax
  under those Parts.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Condition

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No deduction shall be made by a licensed manufacturer
  or licensed wholesaler under subsection (2) or (2.1) unless the
  manufacturer or wholesaler has reduced the amount charged for the
  gasoline or diesel fuel to the purchaser by an amount equal to the
  amount of the deduction and the amount of the reduction is shown
  separately on an invoice for the sale given to the purchaser by the
  manufacturer or wholesaler.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Fuel tax rebate to registered vendor

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where gasoline or diesel fuel has been sold in bulk
  by a registered vendor to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, R.S., 1985, c. 42 (2nd Supp.), s.
    9\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a qualified fisherman for commercial fishing,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a qualified hunter for commercial hunting,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a qualified trapper for commercial trapping,

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a qualified person for use in logging, or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a qualified person for use in mining,

  for the sole use of the purchaser and not for resale and the taxes
  imposed by Parts III and VI have been paid or are payable in respect
  of the gasoline or fuel, a fuel tax rebate in an amount calculated in
  accordance with subsections (8) and (8.01) shall, subject to this
  Part, be paid to that registered vendor if he applies therefor within
  two years after he sold the gasoline or fuel.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Fuel tax rebate to registered vendor
  selling to farmer

  [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} Where gasoline or diesel fuel has been sold in bulk
  by a registered vendor to a qualified farmer for farming purposes, for
  the sole use of the qualified farmer and not for resale and the tax
  imposed by Parts III and VI has been paid or is payable in respect of
  the gasoline or fuel, a fuel tax rebate in an amount calculated in
  accordance with subsections (8.1) and (8.2) shall, subject to this
  Part, be paid to that registered vendor if he applies therefor within
  two years after the sale of the gasoline or fuel.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Condition

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} No fuel tax rebate shall be paid to a registered
  vendor under subsection (4) or (4.1) unless the registered vendor has
  reduced the amount charged for the gasoline or diesel fuel to the
  purchaser by an amount equal to the amount of the fuel tax rebate
  applied for and the amount of the reduction is shown separately on an
  invoice for the sale given to the purchaser by the registered vendor.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Fuel tax rebate to purchaser or
  importer

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} Where gasoline or diesel fuel has been sold to or
  imported by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, R.S., 1985, c. 42 (2nd Supp.), s.
    9\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a fisherman for commercial fishing,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a hunter for commercial hunting,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a trapper for commercial trapping,

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a person for use in logging, or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a person for use in mining,

  for the sole use of the purchaser or importer and not for resale and
  the taxes imposed by Parts III and VI have been paid or are payable in
  respect of the gasoline or fuel and, in the case of a sale, the amount
  charged therefor has not been reduced in accordance with
  subsection (3) or (5), a fuel tax rebate in an amount calculated in
  accordance with subsections (8) and (8.01) shall, subject to this
  Part, be paid to that purchaser or importer if he applies therefor
  within two years after he purchased or imported the gasoline or fuel.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Fuel tax rebate to farmer

  [(6.1)]{.lawlabel} Where gasoline or diesel fuel has been sold to or
  imported by a farmer for farming purposes, for the sole use of the
  farmer for farming purposes and not for resale and the tax imposed by
  Parts III and VI has been paid or is payable in respect of the
  gasoline or fuel and, in the case of a sale, the amount charged
  therefor has not been reduced in accordance with subsection (3) or
  (5), a fuel tax rebate in an amount calculated in accordance with
  subsections (8.1) and (8.2) shall, subject to this Part, be paid to
  that farmer if he applies therefor within two years after the purchase
  or importation of the gasoline or fuel.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limitation

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (2), (2.1), (4), (4.1), (6) and (6.1) do
  not apply in respect of gasoline or diesel fuel

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is to be used to propel a vehicle on a public
    highway;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is to be used other than for a commercial
    purpose; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that is sold or imported

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} on or after January 1, 1990, in respect of the
      tax imposed by Part III, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} on or after January 1, 1991, in respect of the
      tax imposed by Part VI.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amount of fuel tax rebate: Part VI

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (2), (4) and (6), the
  amount of the fuel tax rebate in respect of the tax imposed by Part VI
  shall be calculated at such rate, not exceeding five cents, per litre
  of gasoline or diesel fuel sold or imported as the Governor in Council
  may, on the recommendation of the Minister of Finance, prescribe by
  order or, if no rate is so prescribed, at the rate of three cents per
  litre of gasoline or diesel fuel sold or imported.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amount of fuel tax rebate: Part III

  [(8.01)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (2), (4) and (6),
  the amount of the fuel tax rebate in respect of the tax imposed by
  Part III shall be calculated

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of gasoline, at the rate of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} one cent per litre, where the gasoline was sold
      or imported on or after January 1, 1988 and before April 1, 1988,
      and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} two cents per litre, where the gasoline was sold
      or imported on or after April 1, 1988 and before January 1, 1990;
      and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of diesel fuel, at the rate of one cent
    per litre, where the diesel fuel was sold or imported on or after
    January 1, 1988 and before January 1, 1990.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Farmers' rate: Part VI

  [(8.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (2.1), (4.1) and
  (6.1), the amount of the fuel tax rebate in respect of the tax imposed
  by Part VI shall be calculated at such rate, not exceeding five cents,
  per litre of gasoline or diesel fuel sold or imported as the Governor
  in Council may, on the recommendation of the Minister of Finance,
  prescribe by order or, if no rate is so prescribed, at the rate of
  three and one-half cents per litre of gasoline or diesel fuel sold or
  imported.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Farmers' rate: Part III

  [(8.2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (2.1), (4.1) and
  (6.1), the amount of the fuel tax rebate in respect of the tax imposed
  by Part III shall be calculated

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of gasoline, at the rate of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} three cents per litre, where the gasoline was
      sold or imported on or after January 1, 1987 and before January 1,
      1988,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} four cents per litre, where the gasoline was
      sold or imported on or after January 1, 1988 and before April 1,
      1988, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} five cents per litre, where the gasoline was
      sold or imported on or after April 1, 1988 and before January 1,
      1990; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of diesel fuel, at the rate of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} three cents per litre, where the diesel fuel was
      sold or imported on or after January 1, 1987 and before January 1,
      1988, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} four cents per litre, where the diesel fuel was
      sold or imported on or after January 1, 1988 and before January 1,
      1990.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Diversion

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} Where the amount charged for gasoline or diesel fuel
  to a purchaser is reduced in accordance with subsection (3) or (5) or
  a payment is made under subsection (6) or (6.1) to a purchaser or
  importer of gasoline or diesel fuel and that person sells the gasoline
  or fuel or uses it for a purpose for which the reduction or payment
  could not, at the time of the purchase or importation, have been made,
  the amount of the reduction or payment shall be deemed to be a tax
  under this Act payable by that person,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where that person sells the gasoline or fuel, at
    the time of delivery thereof to the purchaser from him; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where that person uses the gasoline or fuel, at the
    time of the use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(10)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} authorizing the issue of sales tax bulk permits to
    farmers, fishermen, hunters, trappers or other persons who use
    gasoline or diesel fuel for a purpose described in subsection (2) or
    (2.1) and prescribing the terms and conditions of the permits;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the records to be maintained and
    returns to be filed by farmers, fishermen, hunters, trappers or
    other persons holding sales tax bulk permits;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} prescribing the times at which returns referred to
    in paragraph (b) are to be filed;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} authorizing the cancellation of any sales tax bulk
    permit where any term or condition of that permit is not complied
    with or where any provision of this Act or the regulations
    applicable to the person holding the permit is not complied with;
    and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} providing for a system of registration by the
    Minister of persons who regularly sell in bulk gasoline or diesel
    fuel to qualified farmers, qualified fishermen, qualified hunters,
    qualified trappers or qualified persons engaged in logging or
    mining, including, without limiting the generality of the foregoing,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the form and manner of applying for, and the
      procedure for granting, registration,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the terms and conditions on which registration
      may be granted, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the authorization of the Minister to cancel any
      registration where any term or condition of the registration is
      not complied with or where any provision of this Act or the
      regulations applicable to the registered vendor is not complied
      with.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Drawback on certain goods

- **[[70]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-70 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On
  application, the Minister may, under regulations of the Governor in
  Council, grant a drawback of the tax imposed under Part III and paid
  on or in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} goods exported from Canada;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} goods supplied as ships' stores;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} goods used for the equipment, repair or
    reconstruction of ships or aircraft; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} goods delivered to telegraph cable ships proceeding
    on an ocean voyage for use in laying or repairing oceanic telegraph
    cables outside Canadian waters.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Specific sum

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, under regulations of the Governor
  in Council, pay a specific sum in lieu of a drawback under
  subsection (1) in any case where a specific sum in lieu of a drawback
  of duties is granted under section 117 of the [Customs
  Tariff](/eng/acts/C-54.011).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Drawback on imported goods

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} On application, the Minister of Public Safety and
  Emergency Preparedness may, under section 113 of the [Customs
  Tariff](/eng/acts/C-54.011), grant a drawback of the tax imposed under
  Part III and paid on or in respect of goods imported into Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for drawback

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An application for a drawback under subsection (1)
  shall be made in the prescribed form and contain the prescribed
  information and shall be filed with the Minister within such time and
  in such manner as the Governor in Council may, by regulation,
  prescribe.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Evidence

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} No drawback shall be granted under subsection (1)
  unless the person applying for the drawback provides such evidence in
  support of the application as the Minister may require.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2002, c. 22, s. 381\]]{.Repealed}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[70.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-70.1 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this section,

  [[adjustment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[adjustment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} to the sale price of goods
      means the giving of a discount, allowance, rebate or other amount
      as a reduction in the sale price; ([redressement]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[other enactment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[other enactment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a provision of an Act of Parliament, other than
        this Act, enacted before 1991, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a provision of a regulation or order enacted
        under an Act of Parliament before 1991; ([autre
        texte]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[refund]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[refund]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of tax means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a refund of that tax, or other payment
        calculated with reference to that tax, provided for under any of
        sections 68, 68.1, 68.17, 68.19, 68.2 or 68.23 to 68.3,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a drawback of that tax, or payment in lieu of a
        drawback of that tax, provided for under section 70, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a refund, rebate, drawback or remission of that
        tax, or other payment in respect of or calculated with reference
        to that tax, provided for under any other
        enactment; ([remboursement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[registrant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[registrant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned by
      subsection 123(1); ([inscrit]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[tax]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[tax]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means tax imposed under Part
      VI. ([taxe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Adjustments after 1990

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A refund of tax shall not be paid to a person (in
  this subsection referred to as the "vendor") in respect of an
  adjustment made after 1990 to the sale price of goods sold by the
  vendor to a purchaser unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the vendor sold the goods to the purchaser under an
    agreement in writing, paid tax in respect of the sale of the goods,
    calculated on the sale price, and granted the adjustment within two
    years after the day on or before which the vendor was required to
    pay the tax under section 78; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the adjustment is provided for in the agreement and
    the making of the adjustment is not dependent on the performance of
    any service or other act by the purchaser.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exports after 1990

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A refund of tax provided for under section 68.1 or 70
  or any other enactment in respect of goods exported from Canada shall
  not be paid to a person in respect of goods exported by the person
  after 1990 unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person had possession of the goods in Canada at
    the end of 1990 and was not a registrant on January 1, 1991; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person imported the goods, had possession of
    the goods in Canada at the end of 1990 and was not entitled to be
    paid a rebate in respect of the goods under section 120, and the
    goods suffered damage or deterioration at any time before the goods
    were released, were of inferior quality to those in respect of which
    the person paid tax, were defective or were not the goods ordered by
    the person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Goods sold after 1990

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A refund of tax provided for under section 68.17,
  68.2 or 70 or any other enactment in respect of goods sold or
  otherwise supplied or transferred by a person to a purchaser or other
  transferee shall not be paid to the person unless the person
  transferred ownership or possession of the goods to the purchaser or
  other transferee of the goods before 1991.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Goods for use by a province

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A refund of tax shall not be paid under section 68.19
  in respect of goods supplied, transferred or delivered to, or
  purchased by, Her Majesty in right of a province unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} Her Majesty in that right acquired ownership or
    possession of the goods before 1991; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the goods were supplied or transferred to Her
    Majesty in that right by a person in the course of performing
    services under an agreement in writing with Her Majesty in that
    right and the person had possession of the goods in Canada at the
    end of 1990 and was not entitled to be paid a rebate in respect of
    the goods under section 120.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}System goods acquired after 1990

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A refund of tax shall not be paid under section 68.23
  to a person in respect of system goods unless the person acquired
  ownership or possession of the goods before 1991 and was not entitled
  to be paid a rebate in respect of the goods under section 120.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Goods acquired by certain organizations
  after 1990

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} A refund of tax shall not be paid under any of
  sections 68.24 to 68.27 to a person (in this subsection referred to as
  the "organization") unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of goods purchased by the organization,
    the organization acquired ownership or possession of the goods
    before 1991; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of goods acquired or used by another
    person for a purpose for which a refund of tax to the organization
    is provided for under that section, the other person acquired
    ownership or possession of the goods before 1991 and was not
    entitled to be paid a rebate in respect of the goods under section
    120.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other goods acquired after 1990

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} A refund of tax in respect of goods purchased or
  otherwise acquired by a person shall not be paid under any of sections
  68.28 to 68.3 or 70 or any other enactment to the person unless the
  person acquired ownership or possession of the goods before 1991.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Statutory recovery rights only

**[[71]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-71 .sectionLabel}** Except as provided in
this or any other Act of Parliament, no person has a right of action
against Her Majesty for the recovery of any moneys paid to Her Majesty
that are taken into account by Her Majesty as taxes, penalties, interest
or other sums under this Act.

Definition of [[application]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

- **[[72]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-72 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this section, [[application]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an application
  under any of sections 68 to 69.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Form and contents of application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An application shall be made in the prescribed form
  and contain the prescribed information.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Filing of application

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An application shall be filed with the Minister in
  any manner that the Governor in Council may, by regulation, prescribe.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Determination

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of an application, the Minister shall,
  with all due dispatch, consider the application and determine the
  amount, if any, payable to the applicant.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minister not bound

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} In considering an application, the Minister is not
  bound by any application or information supplied by or on behalf of
  any person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice and payment

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} After considering an application, the Minister shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} send to the applicant a notice of determination in
    the prescribed form setting out

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the date of the determination,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount, if any, payable to the applicant,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a brief explanation of the determination, where
      the Minister rejects the application in whole or in part, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the period within which an objection to the
      determination may be made under section 81.17; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} pay to the applicant the amount, if any, payable to
    him.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interest on payment

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} If an amount is paid to an applicant under subsection
  (6), the Minister shall pay interest at the prescribed rate to the
  applicant on the amount for the period beginning on the day that is 30
  days after the day on which the application was received by the
  Minister and ending on the day on which the amount is paid.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2003, c. 15, s. 98\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Determination valid and binding

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} A determination under subsection (4), including a
  determination varied under section 81.17, subject to being varied or
  vacated on an objection or appeal under this Part and subject to an
  assessment, shall be deemed to be valid and binding notwithstanding
  any irregularity, informality, error, defect or omission therein or in
  any proceeding under this Act relating thereto.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Irregularities

  [(10)]{.lawlabel} No determination under subsection (4) shall be
  varied or vacated on an appeal by reason only of an irregularity,
  informality, error, defect or omission by any person in the observance
  of any directory provision of this Act.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deductions of tax, other than Part I tax,
where no application

- **[[73]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-73 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Any
  person authorized pursuant to subsection (4) who files a return under
  section 20, 21.32 or 78 and to whom an amount would be payable under
  any of sections 68 to 68.153 or 68.17 to 69 if that person duly
  applied therefor on the day on which he files the return, in lieu of
  applying for that amount, may in that return report that amount and
  deduct it or any part thereof from the amount of any payment or
  remittance of tax, penalty, interest or other sum that is reported in
  that return.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deductions of Part I tax

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any person who makes a return under subsection 5(1)
  and to whom an amount would be payable under section 68 if the person
  duly applied therefor on the day on which that return is made, in lieu
  of applying for that amount, may in that return report that amount and
  deduct it or any part thereof from the amount of any payment of tax,
  penalty, interest or other sum that is reported in that return.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsequent deductions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a person reports an amount in accordance with
  subsection (1) or (2) and does not deduct the whole amount in the
  return in which it is reported, the person may, in any subsequent
  return, report the amount not previously deducted under this section
  and deduct it or any part thereof from the amount of any payment or
  remittance of tax, penalty, interest or other sum that is reported in
  that subsequent return.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authorizations and terms

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, in writing,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} authorize a specified person, a person of a
    specified class of persons or persons generally to make deductions
    under subsections (1) and (3) either generally or with respect to
    any transaction of a specified class of transactions;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} amend an authorization made pursuant to
    paragraph (a) or suspend or revoke any such authorization either
    generally or with respect to a specified person or a person of a
    specified class of persons; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} specify the terms and conditions on which, and the
    manner in which, deductions may be made under subsection (1), (2) or
    (3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Presumption

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where a person deducts an amount under this section,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person is deemed to have paid, on the day he
    filed or made the return in which the amount was deducted, an amount
    equal to that amount on account of his tax, penalty, interest or
    other sum payable under this Act in respect of the period for which
    the return was filed or made; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister is deemed to have paid, on that day,
    an amount equal to that amount to that person in accordance with
    section 72.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deductions of tax, other than Part I tax,
where application

- **[[74]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-74 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  lieu of making a payment, other than a payment in respect of Part I,
  pursuant to an application under any of sections 68 to 68.11 or 68.17
  to 69, the Minister may, on request of the applicant, authorize the
  applicant to deduct, on such terms and conditions and in such manner
  as the Minister may specify, the amount that would otherwise be paid
  to the applicant from the amount of any payment or remittance of tax,
  penalty, interest or other sum that is reported in a return under
  section 78 by the applicant.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notification of applicant

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister authorizes an applicant to make a
  deduction under subsection (1), the Minister shall notify the
  applicant to that effect in the notice of determination sent to the
  applicant.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interest on deduction

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a deduction is authorized under subsection (1),
  interest shall be authorized at the prescribed rate as a deduction in
  accordance with that subsection for the period beginning on the day
  that is 30 days after the day on which the application for the payment
  in respect of which the deduction was authorized was received by the
  Minister and ending on the day on which the notice of determination
  was sent.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2003, c. 15, s. 99\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Presumption

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where an applicant deducts an amount under this
  section,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant is deemed to have paid, on the day he
    filed the return in which the amount was deducted, an amount equal
    to that amount on account of his tax, penalty, interest or other sum
    payable under this Act in respect of the period for which the return
    was filed; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister is deemed to have paid, on the day the
    notice of determination is sent to the applicant, an amount equal to
    that amount to the applicant in accordance with section 72.

- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]

- R.S., 1985, c. 7 (2nd Supp.), s. 34, c. 12 (4th Supp.), s. 30
- 1997, c. 26, s. 69
- 2001, c. 16, s. 31
- 2003, c. 15, s. 99
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Recovery of deduction from licensee

- **[[75]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-75 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where
  a licensee makes a deduction under section 73 or 74 in lieu of
  receiving a payment pursuant to section 68.15, subsection 68.15(3)
  applies, with such modifications as the circumstances require, with
  respect to the amount of the deduction as if it were a refunded amount
  within the meaning of that subsection.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Recovery of deduction from licensed
  manufacturer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where a licensed manufacturer makes a deduction under
  section 73 or 74 in lieu of receiving a payment pursuant to section
  68.21, subsection 68.21(3) applies, with such modifications as the
  circumstances require, with respect to the amount of the deduction as
  if it were a refunded amount within the meaning of that subsection.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Calculation of payment or deduction

**[[76]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-76 .sectionLabel}** Where circumstances
render it difficult to determine the exact amount of any payment that
may be made pursuant to any of sections 68 to 68.29 or any deduction
that may be made under section 73 or 74, the Minister, with the consent
of the person to whom the payment or by whom the deduction may be made,
may in lieu of that amount make a payment pursuant to, or authorize a
deduction under, that section in an amount determined, in such manner as
the Governor in Council may by regulation prescribe, to be the exact
amount of the payment or deduction.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated

- R.S., 1985, c. E-15, s. 76
- R.S., 1985, c. 15 (1st Supp.), s. 25, c. 7 (2nd Supp.), s. 34
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on refunds and credits

**[[77]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-77 .sectionLabel}** A refund shall not be
paid, and a credit shall not be allowed, to a person under this Act
until the person has filed with the Minister all returns and other
records of which the Minister has knowledge that are required to be
filed under the [Excise Tax Act](/eng/acts/E-15), the [Income Tax
Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3), the [Air Travellers Security Charge
Act](/eng/acts/A-10.5), the [Excise Act, 2001](/eng/acts/E-14.1), the
[Underused Housing Tax Act](/eng/acts/U-0.5), the [Select Luxury Items
Tax Act](/eng/acts/S-8.35), the [Digital Services Tax
Act](/eng/acts/D-1.65) and the [Global Minimum Tax
Act](/eng/acts/G-3.3).

### [Returns and Payment of Tax]{.HTitleText2} {#h-187584 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Determination of fiscal months

- **[[78]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-78 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  fiscal months of a person shall be determined in accordance with the
  following rules:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if fiscal months of the person have been determined
    under subsection 243(2) or (4) for the purposes of Part IX, each of
    those fiscal months is a fiscal month of the person for the purposes
    of this Act;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if fiscal months of the person have not been
    determined under subsection 243(2) or (4) for the purposes of Part
    IX, the person may select for the purposes of this Act fiscal months
    that meet the requirements set out in subsection 243(2); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if neither paragraph (a) nor paragraph (b) applies,
    each calendar month is a fiscal month of the person for the purposes
    of this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Determination of fiscal half-years

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} The fiscal half-years of a person shall be
  determined in accordance with the following rules:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the period beginning on the first day of the first
    fiscal month in a fiscal year of the person and ending on the
    earlier of the last day of the sixth fiscal month and the last day
    in the fiscal year is a fiscal half-year of the person; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the period, if any, beginning on the first day of
    the seventh fiscal month and ending on the last day in the fiscal
    year of the person is a fiscal half-year of the person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notification of Minister

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every person who is required to file a return shall
  notify the Minister of their fiscal months in the prescribed form and
  manner.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- R.S., 1985, c. E-15, s. 78
- R.S., 1985, c. 15 (1st Supp.), s. 26, c. 7 (2nd Supp.), s. 35, c. 12
  (4th Supp.), s. 31
- 2001, c. 16, s. 32
- 2002, c. 22, s. 382
- 2003, c. 15, ss. 100, 130
- 2010, c. 25, s. 128
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reporting period --- general

- **[[78.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-78.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this section, the
  reporting period of a person is a fiscal month.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reporting period --- semi-annual

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On application in the prescribed form and manner by a
  person, the Minister may, in writing, authorize the reporting period
  of that person to be a fiscal half-year in a particular fiscal year if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person has been required to pay tax under Part
    III, or has been holding a licence granted under or in respect of
    that Part, for a period exceeding twelve consecutive fiscal months;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the total of all taxes payable under Part III by
    the person and any person associated with the person in the fiscal
    year ending immediately before the particular fiscal year did not
    exceed \$120,000;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the total of all taxes payable under Part III by
    the person and any person associated with the person in the
    particular fiscal year does not exceed \$120,000; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the person is in compliance with this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed revocation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An authorization under subsection (2) is deemed to be
  revoked if the total of all taxes payable under Part III by the person
  and any person associated with the person exceeds \$120,000 in a
  fiscal year, which revocation is effective as of the first day after
  the end of the fiscal half-year in which the excess occurs.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revocation --- other

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may revoke an authorization if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person requests in writing the Minister to do
    so;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person fails to comply with this Act; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister considers that the authorization is no
    longer required.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of revocation

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister revokes an authorization under
  subsection (4), the Minister shall send a notice in writing of the
  revocation to the person and shall specify in the notice the fiscal
  month for which the revocation becomes effective.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed reporting period on revocation

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} If a revocation under subsection (4) becomes
  effective before the last day of a fiscal half-year of a person that
  is authorized under subsection (2), the period beginning on the first
  day of the fiscal half-year and ending immediately before the first
  day of the fiscal month for which the revocation becomes effective is
  deemed to be a reporting period of the person.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 2010, c. 25, s. 129
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Returns and payments

- **[[79]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-79 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every
  person who is required to pay tax under Part III and every person who
  holds a licence granted under or in respect of that Part shall, not
  later than the last day of the first month after each reporting period
  of the person,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} file a return with the Minister, in the prescribed
    form and manner, for that reporting period;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} calculate, in the return, the total amount of the
    tax payable, if any, by the person for that reporting period, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} pay that amount to the Receiver General.

- [(2) and (3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2010, c. 25, s.
  130\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Demand for return

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, on demand sent by the Minister,
  require a person to file, within any reasonable time stipulated in the
  demand, a return under this Act for any period designated in the
  demand.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Failure to answer a demand

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Every person who fails to file a return as and when
  required under a demand issued under subsection (4) is liable to a
  penalty of \$250.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amounts owing of \$2 or less in total

- **[[79.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-79.02
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister determines, at any
  time, that the total of all amounts owing by a person to Her Majesty
  in right of Canada under this Act does not exceed two dollars, those
  amounts are deemed to be nil.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amounts payable of \$2 or less in total

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, at any time, the total of all amounts payable by
  the Minister to a person under this Act does not exceed two dollars,
  the Minister may apply those amounts against any amount owing, at that
  time, by the person to Her Majesty in right of Canada. However, if the
  person, at that time, does not owe any amount to Her Majesty in right
  of Canada, those amounts payable are deemed to be nil.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 2003, c. 15, s. 100
- 2006, c. 4, s. 129
:::

Version](section-79.02-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 79.02"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compound interest on amounts not paid
when required

- **[[79.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-79.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a person fails to pay an amount
  to the Receiver General as and when required under this Act, the
  person shall pay to the Receiver General interest on the amount. The
  interest shall be compounded daily at the prescribed rate and computed
  for the period beginning on the first day after the day on which the
  amount was required to be paid and ending on the day on which the
  amount is paid.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment of interest that is compounded

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), interest that is
  compounded on a particular day on an unpaid amount of a person is
  deemed to be required to be paid by the person to the Receiver General
  at the end of the particular day, and, if the person has not paid the
  interest so computed by the end of the day after the particular day,
  the interest shall be added to the unpaid amount at the end of the
  particular day.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Period where interest not payable

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite any other provision of this Act, if the
  Minister notifies a person that the person is required to pay a
  specified amount under this Act and the person pays the specified
  amount in full before the end of the period that the Minister
  specifies with the notice, interest is not payable on the specified
  amount for the period.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interest and penalty amounts of \$25 or
  less

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If, at any time, a person pays an amount not less
  than the total of all amounts, other than interest and penalty under
  subsection 7(1.1) or 68.5(9.1) or section 95.1 or 95.2, owing at that
  time to Her Majesty in right of Canada under this Act for a reporting
  period of the person and the total amount of interest and penalty
  payable by the person under this Act for that reporting period is not
  more than \$25.00, the Minister may cancel the interest and penalty.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 2003, c. 15, s. 100
- 2006, c. 4, s. 130
- 2014, c. 20, s. 84
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-79.03-20060622.html "Link to previous version of section 79.03"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compound interest on amounts owed by Her
Majesty

**[[79.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-79.04 .sectionLabel}** Interest shall be
compounded daily at the prescribed rate on any amount payable by the
Minister to a person. The interest shall be computed for the period
beginning on the first day after the day on which the amount is required
to be paid and ending on the day on which the amount is paid or is
applied against an amount owed by the person to Her Majesty in right of
Canada, unless this Act provides otherwise.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 2003, c. 15, s. 100
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of interest provisions if Act
amended

**[[79.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-79.05 .sectionLabel}** For greater
certainty, if a provision of an Act amends this Act and provides that
the amendment comes into force on, or applies as of, a particular day
that is before the day on which the provision is assented to, the
provisions of this Act that relate to the calculation and payment of
interest apply in respect of the amendment as though the provision had
been assented to on the particular day.

  text

:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Filing of return by mail

- **[[79.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-79.2 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  a person who is required under this Act to file a return with the
  Minister does so by mailing the return, the return is deemed to have
  been filed with the Minister on the day on which the return was mailed
  and the date of the postmark is evidence of that day.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment or remittance of amounts

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who is required under this Act to pay or
  remit an amount to the Receiver General shall not be considered as
  having paid or remitted the amount until it is received by the
  Receiver General.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- R.S., 1985, c. 12 (4th Supp.), s. 33
- 1999, c. 17, ss. 150(E), 156
- 2003, c. 15, s. 102
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report by licence holders

- **[[80]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-80 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every
  person holding a licence in respect of Part III shall submit to the
  Minister each year, within six months after the end of that person's
  fiscal year, a report in the prescribed form containing details of
  that person's sales, taxes paid under this Act and deductions under
  subsection 69(2) in the fiscal year and any other prescribed
  information.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Alternate reporting

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any person filing a return under section 79 may, in
  lieu of submitting a report under subsection (1), include in the
  return a report in the prescribed form containing details of the
  person's sales, taxes paid under this Act and deductions under
  subsection 69(2) in the period to which the return relates and any
  other prescribed information.

- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
