        of a loss of the property, the last-known place where the
        property was situated before the loss,

      - [(k)]{.lawlabel} any supply deemed by subsection 150(1) or
        section 158 to be a supply of a financial service,

      - [(l)]{.lawlabel} the agreeing to provide, or the arranging for,
        a service that is

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (i),
          and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} not referred to in any of paragraphs (n) to
          (t), or

      - [(m)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed service,

      but does not include

      - [(n)]{.lawlabel} the payment or receipt of money as
        consideration for the supply of property other than a financial
        instrument or of a service other than a financial service,

      - [(o)]{.lawlabel} the payment or receipt of money in settlement
        of a claim (other than a claim under an insurance policy) under
        a warranty, guarantee or similar arrangement in respect of
        property other than a financial instrument or a service other
        than a financial service,

      - [(p)]{.lawlabel} the service of providing advice, other than a
        service included in this definition because of paragraph (j) or
        (j.1),

      - [(q)]{.lawlabel} the provision, to an investment plan (as
        defined in subsection 149(5)) or any corporation, partnership or
        trust whose principal activity is the investing of funds, of

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a management or administrative service, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any other service (other than a prescribed
          service),

        if the supplier is a person who provides management or
        administrative services to the investment plan, corporation,
        partnership or trust,

      - [(q.1)]{.lawlabel} an asset management service,

      - [(r)]{.lawlabel} a professional service provided by an
        accountant, actuary, lawyer or notary in the course of a
        professional practice,

      - [(r.1)]{.lawlabel} the arranging for the transfer of ownership
        of shares of a cooperative housing corporation,

      - [(r.2)]{.lawlabel} a debt collection service, rendered under an
        agreement between a person agreeing to provide, or arranging
        for, the service and a particular person other than the debtor,
        in respect of all or part of a debt, including a service of
        attempting to collect, arranging for the collection of,
        negotiating the payment of, or realizing or attempting to
        realize on any security given for, the debt, but does not
        include a service that consists solely of accepting from a
        person (other than the particular person) a payment of all or
        part of an account unless

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} under the terms of the agreement the person
          rendering the service may attempt to collect all or part of
          the account or may realize or attempt to realize on any
          security given for the account, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the principal business of the person
          rendering the service is the collection of debt,

      - [(r.3)]{.lawlabel} a service (other than a prescribed service)
        of managing credit that is in respect of credit cards, charge
        cards, credit accounts, charge accounts, loan accounts or
        accounts in respect of any advance and is provided to a person
        granting, or potentially granting, credit in respect of those
        cards or accounts, including a service provided to the person of

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} checking, evaluating or authorizing credit,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} making decisions on behalf of the person in
          relation to a grant, or an application for a grant, of credit,

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} creating or maintaining records for the
          person in relation to a grant, or an application for a grant,
          of credit or in relation to the cards or accounts, or

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} monitoring another person's payment record
          or dealing with payments made, or to be made, by the other
          person,

      - [(r.4)]{.lawlabel} a service (other than a prescribed service)
        that is preparatory to the provision or the potential provision
        of a service referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (i) and
        (l), or that is provided in conjunction with a service referred
        to in any of those paragraphs, and that is

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a service of collecting, collating or
          providing information, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a market research, product design, document
          preparation, document processing, customer assistance,
          promotional or advertising service or a similar service,

      - [(r.5)]{.lawlabel} property (other than a financial instrument
        or prescribed property) that is delivered or made available to a
        person in conjunction with the rendering by the person of a
        service referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (i) and (l),

      - [(r.6)]{.lawlabel} a service (other than a prescribed service)
        that is supplied by a [[payment card network
        operator]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in respect of a [[payment card
        network]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as those terms are defined in
        section 3 of the [Payment Card Networks Act](/eng/acts/P-4.3))
        where the supply includes the provision of

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a service in respect of the authorization of
          a transaction in respect of money, an account, a credit card
          voucher, a charge card voucher or a financial instrument,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a clearing or settlement service in respect
          of money, an account, a credit card voucher, a charge card
          voucher or a financial instrument, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a service rendered in conjunction with a
          service referred to in subparagraph (i) or (ii),

      - [(s)]{.lawlabel} any service the supply of which is deemed under
        this Part to be a taxable supply, or

      - [(t)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed service; ([service
        financier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fiscal month]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fiscal month]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a person means a period
      that is determined under section 243 to be the fiscal month of the
      person; ([mois d'exercice]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fiscal quarter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fiscal quarter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a person means a period
      that is determined under section 243 to be the fiscal quarter of
      the person; ([trimestre d'exercice]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fiscal year]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fiscal year]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a person means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if section 244.1 applies to the person, the
        period determined under that section,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if section 244.1 does not apply to the person
        and the person has made an election under section 244 that is in
        effect, the period that the person elected to be the fiscal year
        of the person, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in all other cases, the taxation year of the
        person; ([exercice]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[floating home]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[floating home]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a structure that is
      composed of a floating platform and a building designed to be
      occupied as a place of residence for individuals that is
      permanently affixed to the platform, but does not include any
      freestanding appliances or furniture sold with the structure or
      any structure that has means of, or is capable of being readily
      adapted for, self-propulsion; ([maison flottante]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[foreign convention]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[foreign convention]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a convention

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} at least 75% of the admissions to which are, at
        the time the sponsor of the convention determines the amount to
        be charged as consideration therefor, reasonably expected to be
        supplied to non-resident persons, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor of which is an organization whose
        head office is situated outside Canada or, where the
        organization has no head office, the member, or majority of
        members, of which having management and control of the
        organization is or are non-resident; ([congrès
        étranger]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[former spouse]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[former spouse]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2000, c. 12, s.
      111\]]{.Repealed}

  [[game of chance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[game of chance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lottery or other
      scheme under which prizes or winnings are awarded by way of chance
      or by way of a mixture of chance and other factors where the
      result depends more on chance than on the other factors; ([jeu de
      hasard]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[goods]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[goods]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in the
      [Customs Act](/eng/acts/C-52.6); ([produits]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[government]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[government]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Her Majesty in right of
      Canada or a province; ([gouvernement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[harmonization date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[harmonization date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} for a participating
      province means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} April 1, 1997 in the case of Nova Scotia, New
        Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, the Nova Scotia offshore
        area or the Newfoundland offshore area,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} July 1, 2010 in the case of Ontario, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the prescribed date in the case of another
        participating province; ([date d'harmonisation]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[hospital authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[hospital authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an organization
      that operates a public hospital and that is designated by the
      Minister as a hospital authority for the purposes of this
      Part; ([administration hospitalière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[import]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[import]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means import into
      Canada; ([importation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[improvement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[improvement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of property of a
      person, means any property or service supplied to, or goods
      imported by, the person for the purpose of improving the property,
      to the extent that the consideration paid or payable by the person
      for the property or service or the value of the goods is, or would
      be if the person were a taxpayer under the [Income Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3), included in determining the cost or, in the
      case of property that is capital property of the person, the
      adjusted cost base to the person of the property for the purposes
      of that Act; ([améliorations]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[individual]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[individual]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a natural
      person; ([Version anglaise seulement]{.DefinitionOtherLangOnly})

  [[insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[insurance policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a policy or contract of insurance (other than a
        warranty in respect of the quality, fitness or performance of
        tangible property, where the warranty is supplied to a person
        who acquires the property otherwise than for resale) that is
        issued by an insurer, including

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a policy of reinsurance issued by an insurer,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an annuity contract issued by an insurer, or
          a contract issued by an insurer that would be an annuity
          contract except that the payments under the contract

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} are payable on a periodic basis at
            intervals that are longer or shorter than one year, or

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} vary in amount depending on the value of a
            specified group of assets or on changes in interest rates,
            and

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a contract issued by an insurer all or part
          of the insurer's reserves for which vary in amount depending
          on the value of a specified group of assets,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a policy or contract in the nature of accident
        and sickness insurance, whether the policy is issued, or the
        contract is entered into, by an insurer, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a bid, performance, maintenance or payment bond
        issued in respect of a construction contract; ([police
        d'assurance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[insurer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[insurer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who is licensed or
      otherwise authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to
      carry on in Canada an insurance business or under the laws of
      another jurisdiction to carry on in that other jurisdiction an
      insurance business; ([assureur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[[inter vivos]{.otherLang lang="la"} trust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[[inter vivos]{.otherLang lang="la"}
      trust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a trust other than a
      testamentary trust; ([Version anglaise
      seulement]{.DefinitionOtherLangOnly})

  [[investment limited partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[investment limited partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      limited partnership, the primary purpose of which is to invest
      funds in property consisting primarily of financial instruments,
      if

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the limited partnership is, or forms part of an
        arrangement or structure that is, represented or promoted as a
        hedge fund, investment limited partnership, mutual fund, private
        equity fund, venture capital fund or other similar collective
        investment vehicle, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the total value of all interests in the limited
        partnership held by listed financial institutions is 50% or more
        of the total value of all interests in the limited
        partnership; ([société en commandite de
        placement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[invoice]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[invoice]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a statement of account, a
      bill and any other similar record, regardless of its form or
      characteristics, and a cash register slip or
      receipt; ([facture]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[listed financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[listed financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      person referred to in paragraph 149(1)(a); ([institution
      financière désignée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[listed international agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[listed international agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Convention on Mutual Administrative
        Assistance in Tax Matters, concluded at Strasbourg on January
        25, 1988, as amended from time to time by a protocol, or other
        international instrument, as ratified by Canada, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a comprehensive tax information exchange
        agreement that Canada has entered into and that has effect, in
        respect of another country or jurisdiction; ([accord
        international désigné]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[management or administrative service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[management or administrative
      service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes an asset management
      service; ([service de gestion ou
      d'administration]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[master pension entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[master pension entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a pension plan
      means a person that is not a pension entity of the pension plan
      and that is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a corporation described in paragraph
        149(1)(o.2) of the [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3), one or
        more shares of which are owned by a pension entity of the
        pension plan, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a trust prescribed to be a master trust for the
        purposes of paragraph 149(1)(o.4) of the [Income Tax
        Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3), one or more units of which are owned by a
        pension entity of the pension plan; ([entité de gestion
        principale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[master pension factor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[master pension factor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of
      a pension plan for a fiscal year of a master pension entity, the
      amount (expressed as a percentage) determined by the formula

      ::: {#189113 .Definition}
      A/B

      where

      [A]{.dfn}
      :   is the total value, on the first day of the fiscal year, of
          the units or shares of the master pension entity that are held
          by pension entities of the pension plan on that day, and

      [B]{.dfn}
      :   is the total value, on the first day of the fiscal year, of
          the units or shares of the master pension entity; ([facteur
          d'entité de gestion principale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})
      :::

  [[membership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[membership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a right granted by a
      particular person that entitles another person to services that
      are provided by, or to the use of facilities that are operated by,
      the particular person and that are not available, or are not
      available to the same extent or for the same fee or charge, to
      persons to whom such a right has not been granted, and also
      includes such a right that is conditional on the acquisition or
      ownership of a share, bond, debenture or other security; ([droit
      d'adhésion]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mineral]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mineral]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes ammonite gemstone,
      bituminous sands, calcium chloride, coal, gravel, kaolin, oil
      shale, silica, sand and petroleum, natural gas and related
      hydrocarbons; ([minéral]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Minister]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Minister]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Minister of National
      Revenue; ([ministre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mobile home]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mobile home]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a building, the
      manufacture and assembly of which is completed or substantially
      completed, that is equipped with complete plumbing, electrical and
      heating facilities and that is designed to be moved to a site for
      installation on a foundation and connection to service facilities
      and to be occupied as a place of residence, but does not include
      any travel trailer, motor home, camping trailer or other vehicle
      or trailer designed for recreational use; ([maison
      mobile]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[money]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[money]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes any currency, cheque,
      promissory note, letter of credit, draft, traveller's cheque, bill
      of exchange, postal note, money order, postal remittance and other
      similar instrument, whether Canadian or foreign, but does not
      include currency the fair market value of which exceeds its stated
      value as legal tender in the country of issuance or currency that
      is supplied or held for its numismatic
      value; ([argent]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[month]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[month]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a period beginning on a
      particular day in a calendar month and ending on

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the day immediately before the day in the next
        calendar month that has the same calendar number as the
        particular day, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the next calendar month does not have a
        day that has the same calendar number as the particular day, the
        last day of that next calendar month; ([mois]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[multiple unit residential complex]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[multiple unit residential complex]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      residential complex that contains more than one residential unit,
      but does not include a condominium complex; ([immeuble
      d'habitation à logements multiples]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[municipality]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[municipality]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an incorporated city, town, village,
        metropolitan authority, township, district, county or rural
        municipality or other incorporated municipal body however
        designated, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} such other local authority as the Minister may
        determine to be a municipality for the purposes of this
        Part; ([municipalité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mutual insurance federation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mutual insurance federation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      corporation each member of which is a mutual insurance corporation
      that is required, under an Act of the legislature of a province,
      to be a member of the corporation, but does not include a
      corporation the main purpose of which is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} related to automobile insurance,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to provide compensation to insurance policy
        holders of, or claimants on, insolvent insurers, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} to establish and manage a guarantee fund, cash
        reserve fund, mutual aid fund or similar fund for the benefit of
        its members and to provide financial assistance with regard to
        losses sustained on the winding-up or dissolution of its
        members; ([fédération de sociétés mutuelles
        d'assurance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mutual insurance group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mutual insurance group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a group that
      consists of

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a mutual insurance federation and its members,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the members of the mutual insurance
        federation are the sole investors in an investment fund, that
        fund, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where there exists a mutual reinsurance
        corporation each member of which is a member of the mutual
        insurance federation and is not entitled to obtain reinsurance
        from any other reinsurance corporation, that mutual reinsurance
        corporation; ([regroupement de sociétés mutuelles
        d'assurance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Newfoundland offshore area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Newfoundland offshore area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      offshore area as defined in section 2 of the [Canada--Newfoundland
      and Labrador Atlantic Accord Implementation and Offshore Renewable
      Energy Management Act](/eng/acts/C-7.5); ([zone extracôtière de
      Terre-Neuve]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[new harmonized value-added tax system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[new harmonized value-added tax system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has
      the same meaning as in subsection 277.1(1); ([nouveau régime de la
      taxe à valeur ajoutée harmonisée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[non-participating province]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[non-participating province]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a province that is not a participating
        province, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} another area in Canada that is outside the
        participating provinces; ([province non
        participante]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[non-profit organization]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[non-profit organization]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person
      (other than an individual, an estate, a trust, a charity, a public
      institution, a municipality or a government) that was organized
      and is operated solely for a purpose other than profit, no part of
      the income of which is payable to, or otherwise available for the
      personal benefit of, any proprietor, member or shareholder thereof
      unless the proprietor, member or shareholder is a club, a society
      or an association the primary purpose and function of which is the
      promotion of amateur athletics in Canada; ([organisme à but non
      lucratif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[non-resident]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[non-resident]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means not resident in
      Canada; ([non résidant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Nova Scotia offshore area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Nova Scotia offshore area]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      offshore area as defined in section 2 of the [Canada--Nova Scotia
      Offshore Petroleum Resources Accord Implementation and Offshore
      Renewable Energy Management Act](/eng/acts/C-7.8); ([zone
      extracôtière de la Nouvelle-Écosse]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[office]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[office]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned by
      subsection 248(1) of the [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3), but
      does not include

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the position of trustee in bankruptcy,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the position of receiver (including the
        position of a receiver within the meaning assigned by subsection
        266(1)), or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the position of trustee of a trust or personal
        representative of a deceased individual where the person who
        acts in that capacity is entitled to an amount for doing so that
        is included in computing, for the purposes of that Act, the
        person's income or, where the person is an individual, the
        person's income from a business; ([charge]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who holds an
      office; ([cadre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[offshore activity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[offshore activity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} when used in connection with an activity
        carried on in the Nova Scotia offshore area, an activity in
        respect of which tax would be imposed under section 212 of the
        [Canada--Nova Scotia Offshore Petroleum Resources Accord
        Implementation and Offshore Renewable Energy Management
        Act](/eng/acts/C-7.8) if this Part were included in the
        definition [[Consumption Tax Acts]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in
        section 211 of the [Canada--Nova Scotia Offshore Petroleum
        Resources Accord Implementation and Offshore Renewable Energy
        Management Act](/eng/acts/C-7.8); and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} when used in connection with an activity
        carried on in the Newfoundland offshore area, an activity in
        respect of which tax would be imposed under section 207 of the
        [Canada--Newfoundland and Labrador Atlantic Accord
        Implementation and Offshore Renewable Energy Management
        Act](/eng/acts/C-7.5) if this Part were included in the
        definition [[Consumption Tax Acts]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in
        section 206 of the [Canada--Newfoundland and Labrador Atlantic
        Accord Implementation and Offshore Renewable Energy Management
        Act](/eng/acts/C-7.5); ([activité extracôtière]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[organizer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[organizer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a convention means a person
      who acquires the convention facility or related convention
      supplies and who organizes the convention for another person who
      is the sponsor of the convention; ([organisateur]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[participating employer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[participating employer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a pension plan
      means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a registered pension plan, an
        employer that has made, or is required to make, contributions to
        the pension plan in respect of the employer's employees or
        former employees, or payments under the pension plan to the
        employer's employees or former employees, and includes an
        employer prescribed for the purposes of the definition
        [[participating employer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection
        147.1(1) of the [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3), and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a pooled registered pension
        plan, an employer that

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} has made, or is required to make,
          contributions to the pension plan in respect of all or a class
          of its employees or former employees, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} has remitted, or is required to remit, to
          the PRPP administrator of the pension plan contributions made
          by members (as defined in subsection 147.5(1) of the [Income
          Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3)) of the pension plan under a
          contract with the PRPP administrator in respect of all or a
          class of its employees; ([employeur
          participant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[participating province]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[participating province]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a province or area referred to in Schedule
        VIII, but does not include the Nova Scotia offshore area or the
        Newfoundland offshore area except to the extent that offshore
        activities are carried on in that area, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if there is a sales tax harmonization agreement
        with the government of a province relating to the new harmonized
        value-added tax system and the province is a prescribed
        province, that province; ([province
        participante]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[passenger vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[passenger vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a [[passenger
      vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} or a [[zero-emission passenger
      vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as those terms are defined in
      subsection 248(1) of the [Income Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3); ([voiture de tourisme]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[patronage dividend]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[patronage dividend]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an amount that is
      deductible under section 135 of the [Income Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3) in computing, for the purposes of that Act,
      the income of the person paying the
      amount; ([ristourne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[pension entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pension entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a pension plan means a
      person in respect of the pension plan that is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a trust governed by the pension plan,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a corporation referred to in paragraph (b) of
        the definition [[pension plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed person; ([entité de
        gestion]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[pension plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pension plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a registered pension
      plan or a pooled registered pension plan

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that governs a trust,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of which a corporation

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is incorporated and operated either

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} solely for the administration of the plan,
            or

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} for the administration of the plan and for
            no other purpose other than acting as trustee of, or
            administering, a trust governed by a retirement compensation
            arrangement (as defined in subsection 248(1) of the [Income
            Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3)), where the terms of the
            arrangement provide for benefits only in respect of
            individuals who are provided with benefits under the plan,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a registered pension plan, is
          accepted by the Minister, under subparagraph 149(1)(o.1)(ii)
          of the [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3), as a funding medium
          for the purpose of the registration of the plan under that
          Act, and

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a pooled registered pension
          plan, is a corporation

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} that is described in paragraph 149(1)(o.2)
            of the [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3), and

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} all of the shares, and rights to acquire
            shares, of the capital stock of which are owned, at all
            times since the date on which it was incorporated, by the
            plan, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in respect of which a person is prescribed for
        the purposes of the definition [[pension
        entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}; ([régime de
        pension]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[permanent establishment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[permanent establishment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a
      particular person, means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a fixed place of business of the particular
        person, including

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a place of management, a branch, an office, a
          factory or a workshop, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a mine, an oil or gas well, a quarry,
          timberland or any other place of extraction of natural
          resources,

        through which the particular person makes supplies, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a fixed place of business of another person
        (other than a broker, general commission agent or other
        independent agent acting in the ordinary course of business) who
        is acting in Canada on behalf of the particular person and
        through whom the particular person makes supplies in the
        ordinary course of business; ([établissement
        stable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an individual, a partnership,
      a corporation, the estate of a deceased individual, a trust, or a
      body that is a society, union, club, association, commission or
      other organization of any kind; ([personne]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[personal property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[personal property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means property that is
      not real property; ([bien meuble]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[personal representative]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[personal representative]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, of a deceased
      individual or the estate of a deceased individual, means the
      executor of the individual's will, the liquidator of the
      individual's succession, the administrator of the estate or any
      person who is responsible under the appropriate law for the proper
      collection, administration, disposition and distribution of the
      assets of the estate; ([représentant personnel]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[personal trust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[personal trust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a testamentary trust, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an [inter vivos]{.otherLang lang="la"} trust
        that is a personal trust (within the meaning assigned by
        subsection 248(1) of the [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3)) all
        the beneficiaries (other than contingent beneficiaries) of which
        are individuals and all the contingent beneficiaries of which,
        if any, are individuals, charities or public
        institutions; ([fiducie personnelle]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[place of amusement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[place of amusement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any premises or
      place, whether or not enclosed, at or in any part of which is
      staged or held any

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} film, slide show, sound and light or similar
        presentation,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} artistic, literary, theatrical, musical or
        other performance, entertainment or exhibition,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} fair, circus, menagerie, rodeo or similar
        event, or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} race, game of chance, athletic contest or other
        contest or game,

      and includes a museum, historical site, zoo, wildlife or other
      park, place where bets are placed and any place, structure,
      apparatus, machine or device the purpose of which is to provide
      any type of amusement or recreation; ([lieu de
      divertissement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[pooled registered pension plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pooled registered pension plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the
      same meaning as in paragraph 149(5)(a); ([régime de pension agréé
      collectif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[precious metal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[precious metal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bar, ingot, coin or
      wafer that is composed of gold, silver or platinum and that is
      refined to a purity level of at least

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 99.5% in the case of gold and platinum, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 99.9% in the case of silver; ([métal
        précieux]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[prescribed]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[prescribed]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a form or the manner of filing a
        form, authorized by the Minister,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the information to be given on a
        form, specified by the Minister,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the manner of making or filing
        an election, authorized by the Minister, and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, prescribed by regulation or
        determined in accordance with rules prescribed by
        regulation; ([Version anglaise
        seulement]{.DefinitionOtherLangOnly})

  [[property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any property, whether real
      or personal, movable or immovable, tangible or intangible,
      corporeal or incorporeal, and includes a right or interest of any
      kind, a share and a chose in action, but does not include
      money; ([bien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[province]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[province]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a participating
      province; ([province]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[PRPP administrator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[PRPP administrator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a pooled registered
      pension plan has the meaning assigned by the definition
      [[administrator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 147.5(1) of
      the [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3); ([administrateur de
      RPAC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[public college]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[public college]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an organization that
      operates a post-secondary college or post-secondary technical
      institute

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that receives from a government or a
        municipality funds that are paid for the purpose of assisting
        the organization in the ongoing provision of educational
        services to the general public, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the primary purpose of which is to provide
        programs of instruction in one or more fields of vocational,
        technical or general education; ([collège
        public]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[public institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[public institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a registered
      charity (within the meaning assigned by subsection 248(1) of the
      [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3)) that is a school authority, a
      public college, a university, a hospital authority or a local
      authority determined under paragraph (b) of the definition
      [[municipality]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} to be a
      municipality; ([institution publique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[public sector body]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[public sector body]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a government or a
      public service body; ([organisme du secteur
      public]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[public service body]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[public service body]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a non-profit
      organization, a charity, a municipality, a school authority, a
      hospital authority, a public college or a university; ([organisme
      de services publics]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[qualifying subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[qualifying subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a particular
      corporation means another corporation in respect of which the
      particular corporation holds qualifying voting control and owns
      not less than 90% of the value and number of the issued and
      outstanding shares, having full voting rights under all
      circumstances, of the capital stock of the other corporation, and
      includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a corporation that is a qualifying subsidiary
        of a qualifying subsidiary of the particular corporation,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the particular corporation is a credit
        union, every other credit union, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where the particular corporation is a member of
        a mutual insurance group, every other member of that
        group; ([filiale déterminée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[real property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[real property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of property in the Province of
        Quebec, immovable property and every lease thereof,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of property in any other place in
        Canada, messuages, lands and tenements of every nature and
        description and every estate or interest in real property,
        whether legal or equitable, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a mobile home, a floating home and any
        leasehold or proprietary interest
        therein; ([immeuble]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[recipient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[recipient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a supply of property or a
      service means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where consideration for the supply is payable
        under an agreement for the supply, the person who is liable
        under the agreement to pay that consideration,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where paragraph (a) does not apply and
        consideration is payable for the supply, the person who is
        liable to pay that consideration, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where no consideration is payable for the
        supply,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a supply of property by way of
          sale, the person to whom the property is delivered or made
          available,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a supply of property
          otherwise than by way of sale, the person to whom possession
          or use of the property is given or made available, and

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a supply of a service, the
          person to whom the service is rendered,

      and any reference to a person to whom a supply is made shall be
      read as a reference to the recipient of the
      supply; ([acquéreur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[record]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[record]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes an account, an agreement,
      a book, a chart or table, a diagram, a form, an image, an invoice,
      a letter, a map, a memorandum, a plan, a return, a statement, a
      telegram, a voucher, and any other thing containing information,
      whether in writing or in any other
      form; ([registre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[registered pension plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[registered pension plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same
      meaning as in paragraph 149(5)(a); ([régime de pension
      agréé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[registrant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[registrant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who is
      registered, or who is required to be registered, under Subdivision
      D of Division V; ([inscrit]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[related convention supplies]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[related convention supplies]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means property
      or services acquired, imported or brought into a participating
      province by a person exclusively for consumption, use or supply by
      the person in connection with a convention, but does not include

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} transportation services, other than a chartered
        service acquired by the person solely for the purpose of
        transporting attendees of the convention between any of the
        convention facilities, places of lodging of the attendees or
        transportation terminals,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} entertainment,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} except for the purposes of subsection 167.2(1)
        and section 252.4, property or services that are food or
        beverages or are supplied to the person under a contract for
        catering, or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} property or services supplied by the person in
        connection with the convention for consideration that is
        separate from the consideration for the admission to the
        convention, unless the recipient of the supply is acquiring the
        property or services exclusively for consumption or use in the
        course of promoting, at the convention, property or services
        supplied by, or a business of, the recipient; ([fournitures
        liées à un congrès]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[release]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[release]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in the
      [Customs Act](/eng/acts/C-52.6); ([dédouanement]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[reporting period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reporting period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a person means the
      reporting period of the person as determined under sections 211.18
      and 245 to 251; ([période de déclaration]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[residential complex]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[residential complex]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that part of a building in which one or more
        residential units are located, together with

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that part of any common areas and other
          appurtenances to the building and the land immediately
          contiguous to the building that is reasonably necessary for
          the use and enjoyment of the building as a place of residence
          for individuals, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that proportion of the land subjacent to the
          building that that part of the building is of the whole
          building,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that part of a building that is

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the whole or part of a semi-detached house,
          rowhouse unit, residential condominium unit or other similar
          premises that is, or is intended to be, a separate parcel or
          other division of real property owned, or intended to be
          owned, apart from any other unit in the building, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a residential unit,

        together with that proportion of any common areas and other
        appurtenances to the building and the land subjacent or
        immediately contiguous to the building that is attributable to
        the unit and that is reasonably necessary for its use and
        enjoyment as a place of residence for individuals,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the whole of a building described in paragraph
        (a), or the whole of a premises described in subparagraph
        (b)(i), that is owned by or has been supplied by way of sale to
        an individual and that is used primarily as a place of residence
        of the individual, an individual related to the individual or a
        former spouse or common-law partner of the individual, together
        with

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a building described in
          paragraph (a), any appurtenances to the building, the land
          subjacent to the building and that part of the land
          immediately contiguous to the building, that are reasonably
          necessary for the use and enjoyment of the building, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a premises described in
          subparagraph (b)(i), that part of any common areas and other
          appurtenances to the building and the land subjacent or
          immediately contiguous to the building that is attributable to
          the unit and that is reasonably necessary for the use and
          enjoyment of the unit,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a mobile home, together with any appurtenances
        to the home and, where the home is affixed to land (other than a
        site in a residential trailer park) for the purpose of its use
        and enjoyment as a place of residence for individuals, the land
        subjacent or immediately contiguous to the home that is
        attributable to the home and is reasonably necessary for that
        purpose, and

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a floating home,

      but does not include a building, or that part of a building, that
      is a hotel, a motel, an inn, a boarding house, a lodging house or
      other similar premises, or the land and appurtenances attributable
      to the building or part, where the building is not described in
      paragraph (c) and all or substantially all of the leases, licences
      or similar arrangements, under which residential units in the
      building or part are supplied, provide, or are expected to
      provide, for periods of continuous possession or use of less than
      sixty days; ([immeuble d'habitation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[residential condominium unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[residential condominium unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      residential complex that is, or is intended to be, a bounded space
      in a building designated or described as a separate unit on a
      registered condominium or strata lot plan or description, or a
      similar plan or description registered under the laws of a
      province, and includes any interest in land pertaining to
      ownership of the unit; ([logement en copropriété]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[residential trailer park]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[residential trailer park]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a person means
      the land that is included in a trailer park of the person or,
      where the person has two or more trailer parks that are
      immediately contiguous to each other, the land that is included in
      those contiguous trailer parks, and any buildings, fixtures and
      other appurtenances to the land that are reasonably necessary for

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the use and enjoyment of sites in the trailer
        parks by individuals residing in or occupying mobile homes, or
        travel trailers, motor homes or similar vehicles or trailers,
        situated or to be situated on those sites, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the purpose of engaging in the business of
        supplying those sites by way of lease, licence or similar
        arrangement,

      but does not include such land and appurtenances or any part of
      them unless the land encompasses at least two sites and all or
      substantially all of the sites in the trailer parks

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} are supplied, or are intended to be supplied,
        under a lease, licence or similar arrangement under which
        continuous possession or use of a site is provided for a period
        of at least

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} one month, in the case of a mobile home or
          other residential unit, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} twelve months, in the case of a travel
          trailer, motor home or similar vehicle or trailer that is not
          a residential unit, and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if the sites were occupied by mobile homes,
        would be suitable for use by individuals as places of residence
        throughout the year; ([parc à roulottes
        résidentiel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[residential unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[residential unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a detached house, semi-detached house, rowhouse
        unit, condominium unit, mobile home, floating home or apartment,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a suite or room in a hotel, a motel, an inn, a
        boarding house or a lodging house or in a residence for
        students, seniors, individuals with a disability or other
        individuals, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any other similar premises,

      or that part thereof that

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} is occupied by an individual as a place of
        residence or lodging,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} is supplied by way of lease, licence or similar
        arrangement for the occupancy thereof as a place of residence or
        lodging for individuals,

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} is vacant, but was last occupied or supplied as
        a place of residence or lodging for individuals, or

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} has never been used or occupied for any
        purpose, but is intended to be used as a place of residence or
        lodging for individuals; ([habitation]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[sale]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[sale]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of property, includes any
      transfer of the ownership of the property and a transfer of the
      possession of the property under an agreement to transfer
      ownership of the property; ([vente]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[sales tax harmonization agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[sales tax harmonization agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the
      same meaning as in subsection 2(1) of the [Federal-Provincial
      Fiscal Arrangements Act](/eng/acts/F-7.8); ([accord
      d'harmonisation de la taxe de vente]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[school authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[school authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an organization
      that operates an elementary or secondary school in which it
      provides instruction that meets the standards of educational
      instruction established by the government of the province in which
      the school is operated; ([administration
      scolaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[secured creditor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[secured creditor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a particular person who has a security interest
        in the property of another person, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a person who acts for or on behalf of the
        particular person with respect to the security interest and
        includes

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a trustee appointed under a trust deed
          relating to a security interest,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a receiver or receiver-manager appointed by
          the particular person or appointed by a court on the
          application of the particular person,

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a sequestrator, or

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any other person performing a function
          similar to that of a person referred to in any of
          subparagraphs (i) to (iii); ([créancier
          garanti]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[security interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[security interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any interest in
      property that secures payment or performance of an obligation, and
      includes an interest created by or arising out of a debenture,
      mortgage, hypothec, lien, pledge, charge, deemed or actual trust,
      assignment or encumbrance of any kind whatever, however or
      whenever arising, created, deemed to arise or otherwise provided
      for; ([droit en garantie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[segregated fund]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[segregated fund]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of an insurer means a
      specified group of properties that is held in respect of insurance
      policies all or part of the reserves for which vary in amount
      depending on the fair market value of the properties; ([fonds
      réservé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[selected listed financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[selected listed financial
      institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, at any time, a listed
      financial institution who is at that time a selected listed
      financial institution under subsection 225.2(1); ([institution
      financière désignée particulière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[self-contained domestic establishment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[self-contained domestic establishment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has
      the meaning assigned by subsection 248(1) of the [Income Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3); ([établissement domestique
      autonome]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means anything other than

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} property,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} money, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} anything that is supplied to an employer by a
        person who is or agrees to become an employee of the employer in
        the course of or in relation to the office or employment of that
        person; ([service]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[short-term accommodation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[short-term accommodation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      residential complex or a residential unit that is supplied to a
      recipient by way of lease, licence or similar arrangement for the
      purpose of its occupancy by an individual as a place of residence
      or lodging, if the period throughout which the individual is given
      continuous occupancy of the complex or unit is less than one month
      and, for the purposes of section 252.4,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} includes any type of overnight shelter (other
        than shelter on a train, trailer, boat or structure that has
        means of, or is capable of being readily adapted for,
        self-propulsion) when supplied as part of a tour package (within
        the meaning assigned by subsection 163(3)) that also includes
        food and the services of a guide, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} does not include a complex or unit when it

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is supplied to the recipient under a
          timeshare arrangement, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is included in that part of a tour package
          that is not the taxable portion of the tour package (within
          the meaning assigned to those expressions by subsection
          163(3)); ([logement provisoire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[single unit residential complex]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[single unit residential complex]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      residential complex that does not contain more than one
      residential unit, but does not include a residential condominium
      unit; ([immeuble d'habitation à logement unique]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[small supplier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[small supplier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, at any time, means a
      person who is at that time a small supplier under section 148 or
      148.1; ([petit fournisseur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specified Crown agent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified Crown agent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed agent of Her Majesty in right of
        Canada, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an agent of Her Majesty in right of a province

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that pays tax because of an agreement under
          section 32 of the [Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements
          Act](/eng/acts/F-7.8) entered into by the government of the
          province, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that is prescribed; ([mandataire de la
          Couronne désigné]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specified motor vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified motor vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} goods that are or would, if they were imported,
        be classified under any of tariff item 8701.20.00, subheading
        Nos. 8701.30 and 8701.90, heading No. 87.02, tariff item
        8703.10.10, subheading Nos. 8703.21 to 8703.90 and 8704.21 to
        8704.90, heading 87.05, tariff items 8711.20.00 to 8711.90.00
        and 8713.90.00, 8716.10.21, 8716.10.29 and 8716.39.30 to
        8716.40.00 and subheading No. 8716.80 of Schedule I to the
        [Customs Tariff](/eng/acts/C-54.011), other than racing cars
        classified under heading No. 87.03 of that Schedule and
        prescribed motor vehicles, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} prescribed motor vehicles; ([véhicule à moteur
        déterminé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specified tangible personal property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified tangible personal property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      property that is, or is an interest in,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a print, an etching, a drawing, a painting, a
        sculpture or other similar work of art,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} jewellery,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a rare folio, a rare manuscript or a rare book,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a stamp,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a coin, or

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} prescribed personal property; ([bien meuble
        corporel désigné]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[sponsor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[sponsor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a convention means the person
      who convenes the convention and supplies admissions to
      it; ([promoteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[straddle plant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[straddle plant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a natural gas
      processing plant devoted primarily to the recovery of natural gas
      liquids or ethane from natural gas that is transported by pipeline
      to the plant by a common carrier of natural gas; ([installation de
      traitement complémentaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[substantial renovation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[substantial renovation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a residential
      complex means the renovation or alteration of the whole or that
      part of a building, as described in whichever of paragraphs (a)
      to (e) of the definition [[residential
      complex]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} is applicable to the residential
      complex, in which one or more residential units are located to
      such an extent that all or substantially all of the building or
      part, as the case may be, other than the foundation, external
      walls, interior supporting walls, floors, roof, staircases and, in
      the case of that part of a building described in paragraph (b) of
      that definition, the common areas and other appurtenances, that
      existed immediately before the renovation or alteration was begun
      has been removed or replaced if, after completion of the
      renovation or alteration, the building or part, as the case may
      be, is, or forms part of, a residential complex; ([rénovations
      majeures]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Superintendent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Superintendent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Superintendent of
      Financial Institutions appointed pursuant to the [Office of the
      Superintendent of Financial Institutions
      Act](/eng/acts/O-2.7); ([surintendant]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[supplier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[supplier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a supply, means
      the person making the supply; ([Version anglaise
      seulement]{.DefinitionOtherLangOnly})

  [[supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, subject to sections 133 and
      134, the provision of property or a service in any manner,
      including sale, transfer, barter, exchange, licence, rental,
      lease, gift or disposition; ([fourniture]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[tax]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[tax]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means tax payable under this
      Part; ([taxe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[taxable supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[taxable supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a supply that is made
      in the course of a commercial activity; ([fourniture
      taxable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[taxation year]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[taxation year]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a person means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the person is a taxpayer, within the
        meaning of that term in the [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3)
        (other than an unincorporated person exempt because of
        subsection 149(1) of that Act from tax under Part I of that Act
        on all or part of the person's taxable income), the taxation
        year of the person for the purposes of that Act,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the person is a partnership described in
        subparagraph 249.1(1)(b)(ii) of that Act, the fiscal period of
        the person's business determined under subsection 249.1(1) of
        that Act, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the period that would be the
        taxation year of the person for the purposes of that Act if the
        person were a corporation other than a professional corporation
        (within the meaning assigned by subsection 248(1) of that
        Act); ([année d'imposition]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Tax Court]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Tax Court]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Tax Court of
      Canada; ([Version anglaise seulement]{.DefinitionOtherLangOnly})

  [[tax fraction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[tax fraction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 1997, c. 10, s.
      150\]]{.Repealed}

  [[taxi business]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[taxi business]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a business carried on in Canada of transporting
        passengers by taxi or other similar vehicle for fares that are
        regulated under the laws of Canada or a province, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a business carried on in Canada by a person of
        transporting passengers for fares by motor vehicle --- being a
        vehicle that would be an [[automobile]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef},
        as defined in subsection 248(1) of the [Income Tax
        Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3), if that definition were read without
        reference to "a motor vehicle acquired primarily for use as a
        taxi," in its paragraph (c) and without reference to its
        paragraph (e) --- within a particular municipality and its
        environs if the transportation is arranged or coordinated
        through an electronic platform or system, other than

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the part of the business that does not
          involve the making of taxable supplies by the person,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the part of the business that is the
          operation of a sightseeing service or the school
          transportation of elementary or secondary students, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed business or a prescribed
          activity of a business; ([entreprise de
          taxis]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[tax rate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[tax rate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, for or in relation to a
      participating province, means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if there is a sales tax harmonization agreement
        with the government of the participating province relating to
        the new harmonized value-added tax system, the rate that is
        prescribed for the participating province,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the participating province is an offshore
        area referred to in the definition [[participating
        province]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, the rate that is prescribed
        for the participating province, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the absence of a rate that is prescribed for
        the participating province, the rate set opposite the name of
        the participating province in Schedule VIII; ([taux de
        taxe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[telecommunication service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[telecommunication service]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the service of emitting, transmitting or
        receiving signs, signals, writing, images or sounds or
        intelligence of any nature by wire, cable, radio, optical or
        other electromagnetic system, or by any similar technical
        system, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} making available for such emission,
        transmission or reception telecommunications facilities of a
        person who carries on the business of supplying services
        referred to in paragraph (a); ([service de
        télécommunication]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[telecommunications facility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[telecommunications facility]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any
      facility, apparatus or other thing (including any wire, cable,
      radio, optical or other electromagnetic system, or any similar
      technical system, or any part thereof) that is used or is capable
      of being used for telecommunications; ([installation de
      télécommunication]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[testamentary trust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[testamentary trust]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning
      assigned by subsection 248(1) of the [Income Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3); ([fiducie testamentaire]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[trailer park]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[trailer park]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a person means a piece of
      land that is owned by or leased to the person and that is
      exclusively composed of

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} one or more sites each of which is, or is
        intended to be, supplied by the person by way of lease, licence
        or similar arrangement to the owner, lessee or person in
        occupation or possession of a mobile home, or a travel trailer,
        motor home or similar vehicle or trailer, situated or to be
        situated on the site, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} other land that is reasonably necessary for

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the use and enjoyment of the sites by
          individuals residing in or occupying mobile homes, or travel
          trailers, motor homes or similar vehicles or trailers,
          situated or to be situated on those sites, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the purpose of engaging in the business of
          supplying the sites by way of lease, licence or similar
          arrangement; ([parc à roulottes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[university]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[university]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a recognized
      degree-granting institution or an organization that operates a
      college affiliated with, or a research body of, such an
      institution; ([université]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[used tangible personal property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[used tangible personal property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      tangible personal property that has been used in Canada; ([bien
      meuble corporel d'occasion]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[virtual payment instrument]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[virtual payment instrument]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means property
      that is a digital representation of value, that functions as a
      medium of exchange and that only exists at a digital address of a
      publicly distributed ledger, other than property that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} confers a right, whether immediate or future
        and whether absolute or contingent, to be exchanged or redeemed
        for money or specific property or services or to be converted
        into money or specific property or services,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is primarily for use within, or as part of, a
        gaming platform, an affinity or rewards program or a similar
        platform or program, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is prescribed property; ([effet de paiement
        virtuel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[zero-rated supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[zero-rated supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a supply included
      in Schedule VI. ([fourniture détaxée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Meaning of
  [[Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), in this Part,
  [[Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the sea bed and subsoil of the submarine areas
    adjacent to the coasts of Canada in respect of which the government
    of Canada or of a province may grant a right, licence or privilege
    to explore for or exploit any minerals; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the seas and airspace above the submarine areas
    referred to in paragraph (a) in respect of any activities carried on
    in connection with the exploration for or exploitation of minerals.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} In or in respect of Division III,
  [[Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} has the same meaning as in the
  [Customs Act](/eng/acts/C-52.6).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of provisions to schedules

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Any provision of this Part that applies for the
  purposes of this Part also applies for the purposes of Schedules V to
  X.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compound interest

- **[[124]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-124
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Interest computed at a prescribed
  rate and any penalty computed at a rate per year under any provision
  of this Part shall be compounded daily.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where, on any day, both penalty computed at a rate
  per year and interest are required to be compounded, they shall, on
  that day, be compounded together at a single rate equal to the total
  of the penalty rate and the interest rate as though both the penalty
  and interest were interest computed at that single rate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of interest

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where an amendment to this Part, or an amendment or
  an enactment that relates to this Part,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} applies to a person who did something or to or for
    whom something was done,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} applies to property or a service that was supplied
    or in respect of which something was done,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} applies to an event or a transaction that occurred,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} applies to a period all or part of which is, or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} comes into force on a particular day that is,

  before the day the amendment or enactment is assented to or
  promulgated, for the purposes of applying the provisions of this Part
  that relate to or that provide for the payment, or the liability for
  payment, of interest in respect of any amount, the amount shall be
  determined and interest shall be computed thereon as though the
  amendment or enactment had been assented to or promulgated before the
  thing was done, the supply was made, the occurrence of the event or
  transaction, the beginning of the period or the particular day, as the
  case may be.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (3) does not apply for the purposes of
  computing any penalties under this Part.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 1990, c. 45, s. 12
- 1993, c. 27, s. 11
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Negative amounts

**[[125]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-125 .sectionLabel}** Except as specifically
otherwise provided, where an amount or a number is required under this
Part to be determined or calculated by or in accordance with an
algebraic formula, if the amount or number when so determined or
calculated would, but for this section, be a negative amount or number,
it shall be deemed to be nil.
