- 1994, c. 9, s. 6
- 1997, c. 10, s. 10
:::

#### [Financial Institutions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-190136 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Financial institutions

- **[[149]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-149 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purposes of this Part, a person is a financial institution
  throughout a particular taxation year of the person if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a bank,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a corporation that is licensed or otherwise
      authorized under the laws of Canada or a province to carry on in
      Canada the business of offering to the public its services as a
      trustee,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a person whose principal business is as a
      trader or dealer in, or as a broker or salesperson of, financial
      instruments or money,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a credit union,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} an insurer or any other person whose principal
      business is providing insurance under insurance policies,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} a segregated fund of an insurer,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation,

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} a person whose principal business is the
      lending of money or the purchasing of debt securities or a
      combination thereof,

    - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} an investment plan,

    - [(x)]{.lawlabel} a person providing services referred to in
      section 158, or

    - [(xi)]{.lawlabel} a corporation deemed under section 151 to be a
      financial institution,

    at any time in the particular year;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the total (in this section referred to as the
    "financial revenue") of all amounts each of which is an amount that
    is interest, a dividend (other than a dividend in kind or a
    patronage dividend) or a separate fee or charge for a financial
    service and that is included in computing, for the purposes of the
    [Income Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3), the person's income, or, if the
    person is an individual, the person's income from a business, for
    the taxation year of the person preceding the particular year
    exceeds the greater of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} 10% of the total of

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the amount that would, but for subsection (4),
        be the financial revenue, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the total of all consideration that became due
        in that preceding taxation year, or that was paid in that
        preceding taxation year without having become due, to the person
        for supplies (other than supplies by way of sale of capital
        property of the person and supplies of financial services that
        are not zero-rated supplies described by section 3 of Part IX of
        Schedule VI) made by the person, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined by the formula

      ::: {#190158 .Subparagraph}
      \$10,000,000 × A/365

      where

      [A]{.dfn}
      :   is the number of days in that preceding taxation year; or
      :::

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the total of all amounts each of which is an amount
    that is included in computing, for the purposes of that Act, the
    person's income, or, where the person is an individual, the person's
    income from a business, for that preceding taxation year and that is
    interest, or a separate fee or charge, with respect to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a credit card or charge card issued by the
      person, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the making of an advance, the lending of money
      or the granting of credit

    exceeds

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined by the formula

      ::: {#190166 .Subparagraph}
      \$1,000,000 × A/365

      where

      [A]{.dfn}
      :   is the number of days in that preceding taxation year.
      :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amalgamations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} at any time two or more corporations (in this
    subsection referred to as the "predecessors") are merged or
    amalgamated to form one corporation (in this subsection referred to
    as the "new corporation"), and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the principal business of the new corporation
    immediately after that time is the same as or similar to the
    business of one or more of the predecessors that immediately before
    that time was a financial institution,

  the new corporation is a financial institution throughout the taxation
  year of the new corporation that began at that time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acquisition of business

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a particular person, at any time in a taxation year
    of the particular person, acquires a business as a going concern
    from another person who was immediately before that time a financial
    institution, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} immediately after that time the principal business
    of the particular person is the business so acquired,

  the particular person is a financial institution throughout the part
  of that taxation year that is after that time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exclusion of interest and dividend

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} In determining a total for a person under paragraph
  (1)(b) or (c), there shall not be included interest, or any dividend,
  from

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the person is a partnership, a corporation that
    is controlled by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the person,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a corporation that is controlled by the person,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a corporation that is related to a corporation
      described in subparagraph (ii), or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a combination of persons described in
      subparagraphs (i) to (iii); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, a corporation related to the
    person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exclusion --- sales of precious metals

  [(4.01)]{.lawlabel} In determining an amount of financial revenue,
  there shall not be included a separate fee or charge for a financial
  service the supply of which is a zero-rated supply described by
  section 3 of Part IX of Schedule VI.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exclusion of interest

  [(4.02)]{.lawlabel} In determining a total under paragraph (1)(c) for
  a person (in this subsection and subsection (4.03) referred to as the
  "depositor"), interest from another person in respect of a deposit of
  money received or held by the other person in the usual course of its
  deposit-taking business is not to be included if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the other person is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a bank,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a credit union,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a corporation authorized under the laws of
      Canada or a province to carry on the business of offering to the
      public its services as a trustee, or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a corporation authorized under the laws of
      Canada or a province to accept deposits from the public and that
      carries on the business of lending money on the security of real
      property or investing in indebtedness on the security of mortgages
      or hypothecs on real property; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the other person is obligated, or may by the demand
    of the depositor become obligated, to repay the money on or before
    the particular day that is 364 days after the day on which the
    deposit of money is made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Repayment obligation --- special cases

  [(4.03)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph (4.02)(b), in
  determining whether the other person is obligated, or may by the
  demand of the depositor become obligated, to repay the money on or
  before the particular day that is 364 days after the day on which the
  deposit of money is made, the following rules apply:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the other person is obligated to repay the money
    to the depositor on a fixed day and also is or may become obligated
    to repay the money on an earlier day by virtue of a right of
    withdrawal, reinvestment or other right afforded to the depositor by
    the terms under which the money was solicited or received or is
    held, then only the obligation to repay on the fixed day is to be
    considered, whether or not the right is exercised; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the other person is obligated to repay the money
    to the depositor on a fixed day and also is or may become obligated
    to repay the money on a later day by virtue of a right afforded to
    any person to extend the term of the deposit at a rate or rates of
    interest determined at the time the money was solicited or received,
    then only the obligation to repay on the later day is to be
    considered, whether or not the right is exercised.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Charities, municipalities, etc.

  [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} Paragraphs (1)(b) and (c) do not apply for the
  purpose of determining if a person is a financial institution
  throughout a particular taxation year where the person is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} at the beginning of the particular year,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a charity, municipality, school authority,
      hospital authority, public college or university, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a non-profit organization that operated,
      otherwise than for profit, a health care facility within the
      meaning of paragraph (c) of the definition of that expression in
      section 1 of Part II of Schedule V; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} on the last day of the taxation year of the person
    preceding the particular year, a qualifying non-profit organization
    (within the meaning of subsection 259(2)).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Meaning of [[investment
  plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[investment
  plan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a trust governed by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a registered pension plan,

    - [(i.1)]{.lawlabel} a pooled registered pension plan,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an employees profit sharing plan,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a registered supplementary unemployment benefit
      plan,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a registered retirement savings plan,

    - [(iv.1)]{.lawlabel} a TFSA,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a deferred profit sharing plan,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} a registered education savings plan,

    - [(vi.1)]{.lawlabel} a registered disability savings plan,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} a registered retirement income fund,

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} an employee benefit plan,

    - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} an employee trust,

    - [(x)]{.lawlabel} a mutual fund trust,

    - [(xi)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2017, c. 33, s. 109\]]{.Repealed}

    - [(xii)]{.lawlabel} a unit trust, or

    - [(xiii)]{.lawlabel} a retirement compensation arrangement,

    as each of those terms is defined for the purposes of the [Income
    Tax Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3) or the [Income Tax
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._945);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an investment corporation, as that term is defined
    for the purposes of that Act;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a mortgage investment corporation, as that term is
    defined for the purposes of that Act;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a mutual fund corporation, as that term is defined
    for the purposes of that Act;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a non-resident owned investment corporation, as
    that term is defined for the purposes of that Act;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a corporation exempt from tax under that Act by
    reason of paragraph 149(1)(o.1) or (o.2) of that Act;

  - [(f.1)]{.lawlabel} an investment limited partnership; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed person or a person of a prescribed
    class.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Election for exempt supplies

- **[[150]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-150 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purposes of this Part, where at any time a person who is a member
  of a closely related group of which a listed financial institution is
  a member files an election made jointly by the person and a
  corporation that is also a member of the group at that time, every
  supply between the person and the corporation of property by way of
  lease, licence or similar arrangement or of a service that is made at
  a time when the election is in effect and that would, but for this
  subsection, be a taxable supply is deemed to be a supply of a
  financial service.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} property held or services rendered by a member of a
    closely related group as a participant in a joint venture with
    another person while an election under section 273 made jointly by
    the member and the other person is in effect;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an imported taxable supply, as defined in section
    217; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a supply of services in relation to the clearing or
    settlement of cheques and other payment items under the national
    payments system of the Canadian Payments Association if the
    recipient (in this paragraph referred to as the "related purchaser")
    is acquiring all or part of those services for the purpose of making
    a supply of exempt services to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an unrelated party, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a supplier that is a member of a closely related
      group of which the related purchaser is a member and that acquires
      all or part of the exempt services for the purpose of making a
      supply of exempt services to an unrelated party or to a supplier
      described by this subparagraph.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in subsection (2).

  [[exempt services]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[exempt services]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means services prescribed
      by section 3 of the Financial Services (GST/HST)
      Regulations. ([services exonérés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[unrelated party]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[unrelated party]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a supply of
      services, means a person that is not a member of a closely related
      group of which the supplier is a member and that is acquiring the
      services for the purpose of making a supply of services in
      relation to the clearing or settlement of cheques and other
      payment items under the national payments system of the Canadian
      Payments Association. ([tiers non lié]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Form and manner of filing

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An election under subsection (1) relating to supplies
  between a member of a closely related group and a corporation shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be made in prescribed form containing prescribed
    information;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} specify the day the election is to become
    effective; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be filed by the member with the Minister in
    prescribed manner on or before the day on or before which a return
    under Division V for the reporting period of the member in which the
    election is to become effective is required to be filed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of election

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} An election under subsection (1) shall be effective
  for the period beginning on the day specified in the election and
  ending on the earliest of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the day either member ceases to be a member of the
    closely related group,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the first day the closely related group does not
    include a listed financial institution (other than a person that is
    a financial institution only by reason of section 151), and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the day specified in the revocation of the
    election, which day is at least 365 days after the day specified in
    the election.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Form of revocation

  [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} A revocation of an election made under
  subsection (1) by a member of a closely related group and a
  corporation shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be made jointly in prescribed form containing
    prescribed information by the member and the corporation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} specify the day on which the revocation is to
    become effective; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be filed with the Minister in prescribed manner on
    or before

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the particular day that is the earlier of

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the day on or before which the member is
        required to file a return under Division V for the reporting
        period of the member that includes the day specified in the
        revocation, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the day on or before which the corporation is
        required to file a return under Division V for the reporting
        period of the corporation that includes the day specified in the
        revocation, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any day after the particular day that the
      Minister may allow.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsequent elections

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where an election made under subsection (1) jointly
  by a member of a closely related group and a corporation ceases to be
  effective, the member and the corporation shall not thereafter make an
  election jointly under subsection (1) without the written concurrence
  of the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Credit unions deemed to have elected

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} every credit union shall be deemed to be at all
    times a member of a closely related group of which every other
    credit union is a member;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} every credit union shall be deemed to have made an
    election under subsection (1) with every other credit union that is
    in effect at all times; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} every supply of tangible personal property by a
    credit union, other than a capital property of the credit union, to
    another credit union shall be deemed to be a supply of a financial
    service.

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 1993, c. 27, s. 25\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Mutual insurance group --- deemed
  election

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, every member of a
  mutual insurance group shall be deemed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to be at all times a member of a closely related
    group of which every other member of the mutual insurance group is a
    member; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to have made, with every other member of the group,
    an election under subsection (1) that is in effect at all times.

- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of election under subsection
150(1)

**[[151]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-151 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
this Part, where a corporation that is a member of a closely related
group has made an election under subsection 150(1), the corporation
shall be deemed to be a financial institution throughout the period
during which the election is in effect.

  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 1990, c. 45, s. 12

#### [Consideration]{.HTitleText3} {#h-190272 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When consideration due

- **[[152]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-152 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purposes of this Part, the consideration, or a part thereof, for a
  taxable supply shall be deemed to become due on the earliest of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the earlier of the day the supplier first issues an
    invoice in respect of the supply for that consideration or part and
    the date of that invoice,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the day the supplier would have, but for an undue
    delay, issued an invoice in respect of the supply for that
    consideration or part, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the day the recipient is required to pay that
    consideration or part to the supplier pursuant to an agreement in
    writing.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consideration under leases, etc.

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), where property is
  supplied by way of lease, licence or similar arrangement under an
  agreement in writing, the consideration, or any part thereof, for the
  supply shall, for the purposes of this Part, be deemed to become due
  on the day the recipient is required to pay the consideration or part
  to the supplier pursuant to the agreement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payment

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, where consideration
  that is not money is given or required to be given, the consideration
  that is given or required to be given shall be deemed to be paid or
  required to be paid, as the case may be.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 1990, c. 45, s. 12
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Value of consideration

- **[[153]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-153
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Division, the value
  of the consideration, or any part thereof, for a supply shall, for the
  purposes of this Part, be deemed to be equal to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the consideration or that part is expressed
    in money, the amount of the money; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the consideration or that part is other than
    money, the fair market value of the consideration or that part at
    the time the supply was made.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Combined consideration

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} consideration is paid for a supply and other
    consideration is paid for one or more other supplies or matters, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the consideration for one of the supplies or
    matters exceeds the consideration that would be reasonable if the
    other supply were not made or the other matter were not provided,

  the consideration for each of the supplies and matters shall be deemed
  to be that part of the total of all amounts, each of which is
  consideration for one of those supplies or matters, that may
  reasonably be attributed to each of those supplies and matters.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Barters between registrants

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the consideration or a part of the consideration
    for a supply of property of a particular class or kind is property
    of that class or kind,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} both the supplier and the recipient are
    registrants, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the property is acquired by the recipient and the
    consideration or that part thereof is acquired by the supplier as
    inventory for use exclusively in commercial activities of the
    recipient or supplier, as the case may be,

  the value of the consideration or that part thereof shall be deemed to
  be nil.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Used tangible personal property
  trade-ins

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where, at the time a supplier makes a supply of
  tangible personal property to a recipient, the supplier accepts, in
  full or partial consideration for the supply, other property (in this
  subsection and subsection (5) referred to as the "trade-in") that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is used tangible personal property or a leasehold
    interest therein, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is acquired for consumption, use or supply in the
    course of a commercial activity of the supplier,

  and the recipient is not required to collect tax in respect of the
  supply of the trade-in, the value of the consideration for the supply
  made by the supplier is deemed, for the purposes of this Part, to be
  equal to the amount, if any, by which the value of the consideration
  for that supply (as otherwise determined under this Part) exceeds

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} except where paragraph (d) applies, the amount
    credited to the recipient in respect of the trade-in, and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} where the supplier and the recipient are not
    dealing with each other at arm's length at the time the supply is
    made and the amount credited to the recipient in respect of the
    trade-in exceeds the fair market value of the trade-in at the time
    ownership thereof is transferred to the supplier, that fair market
    value.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale-leaseback arrangements

  [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person (in this subsection and subsections (4.2)
    to (4.5) referred to as the "lessee") makes a supply by way of sale
    of tangible personal property to another person (in this subsection
    referred to as the "lessor"),

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the lessee is not required to collect tax in
    respect of that supply, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the lessor immediately makes a taxable supply by
    way of lease of the property to the lessee under an agreement (in
    this subsection and subsections (4.2) to (4.5) referred to as the
    "original leaseback agreement"),

  the value of the consideration for a supply of the property by way of
  lease that, at a particular time, becomes due or is paid without
  having become due under a particular agreement that is the original
  leaseback agreement or a subsequent lease in respect of that agreement
  is deemed to be equal to the amount determined by the formula

  ::: {#190314 .Subsection}
  A - B

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the value of that consideration as otherwise determined under
      this Part, and

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the amount (in this subsection referred to as the "purchase
      credit") that is equal to the least of
      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the value of A,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount determined by the formula

        ::: {#190320 .NestedFormula}
        B~1~/B~2~

        where

        [B~1~]{.dfn}
        :   is the amount (in this subsection and subsection (4.5)
            referred to as the "unused total purchase credit"), if any,
            by which the consideration for the supply by way of sale
            exceeds the total of all amounts each of which is the
            purchase credit that was determined in calculating the
            amount deemed under this subsection to be the value of any
            consideration that, before the particular time, became due
            or was paid without having become due under the original
            leaseback agreement or a subsequent lease in respect of that
            agreement, and

        [B~2~]{.dfn}
        :   is the specified number of remaining lease payments under
            the particular agreement at the particular time, and
        :::

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} if there is no unused total purchase credit,
        zero.
  :::

- Meaning of [[specified number of remaining lease
  payments]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(4.2)]{.lawlabel} In subsection (4.1), the [[specified number of
  remaining lease payments]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, at a particular time,
  in respect of a particular agreement for the supply of property by way
  of lease that is an original leaseback agreement or a subsequent lease
  in respect of that agreement, is the amount determined by the formula

  ::: {#190327 .Subsection}
  A - B

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the total number of payments that the lessee was obligated to
      make as consideration for the supplies of the property by way of
      lease under the particular agreement based on the terms of that
      agreement at the time it was entered into; and

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the total number of the payments referred to in the description
      of A that, before the particular time, became due or were paid by
      the lessee.
  :::

- Meaning of [[subsequent lease]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(4.3)]{.lawlabel} In subsections (4.1) to (4.5), [[subsequent
  lease]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an original leaseback
  agreement for the supply by way of lease of property to a lessee,
  means

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an agreement for the supply by way of lease of the
    property that constitutes a new agreement between the lessee and an
    assignee of the rights and obligations of the person who is the
    supplier under the original leaseback agreement or under an
    agreement referred to in this paragraph or in paragraph (b); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an agreement for the supply of the property to the
    lessee by way of lease that succeeds, as a new agreement, either the
    original leaseback agreement or a particular agreement referred to
    in paragraph (a) or in this paragraph upon a renewal or variation of
    that original leaseback agreement or particular agreement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed subsequent lease

  [(4.4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (4.1), (4.2) and
  (4.5), if a supplier agrees, at any time, to renew, vary, terminate
  (otherwise than upon the exercise of an option to purchase) or assign
  a particular agreement for the supply of property to a lessee by way
  of lease that is an original leaseback agreement or a subsequent lease
  in respect of that agreement and the renewal, variation, termination
  or assignment does not constitute a novation of the particular
  agreement but has the effect of changing the number of payments that
  the lessee is obligated to make for supplies by way of lease of the
  property under the particular agreement,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the supplier and lessee are deemed to have, at that
    time, entered into a subsequent lease in respect of the original
    leaseback agreement; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all supplies by way of lease for which
    consideration becomes due, or is paid without having become due, at
    or after the time the renewal, variation, termination or assignment
    takes effect that would, but for this subsection, be made under the
    particular agreement are deemed to be made under that subsequent
    lease and not under the particular agreement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exercise of option to purchase

  [(4.5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part other than a purpose
  referred to in paragraph (5)(a), if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a supply by way of sale of property is made to a
    lessee on the exercise by the lessee of an option to purchase the
    property provided for in an original leaseback agreement entered
    into by the lessee in respect of the property, or in a subsequent
    lease in respect of that agreement, to which subsection (4.1)
    applied, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} immediately before the earliest time at which
    consideration for the supply becomes due or is paid without having
    become due, there is an unused total purchase credit in respect of
    the property,

  the following rules apply:

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the value of the consideration for the supply is
    deemed to be equal to the amount determined by the formula

    ::: {#190345 .Paragraph}
    A - B

    where

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the value of that consideration as otherwise determined under
        this Part, and

    [B]{.dfn}
    :   is that unused total purchase credit, and
    :::

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} subsection (4.1) does not apply to any
    consideration that, after that earliest time, becomes due or is paid
    without having become due for any supply by way of lease of the
    property that was made under the original leaseback agreement or
    under a subsequent lease in respect of that agreement.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-arm's length supplies

  [(4.6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (4.1), if a person
  makes a supply by way of sale of property to a recipient with whom the
  person is not dealing at arm's length and the consideration for the
  supply exceeds the fair market value of the property at the time
  ownership of the property is transferred to the recipient, the
  consideration for the supply is deemed to be equal to that fair market
  value.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (4) and (4.1) do not apply

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of determining, for the purposes of
    any provision of this Part or any Schedule to this Act other than
    Schedules I to IV, whether the value of consideration for a supply
    of property equals, exceeds or is less than another amount specified
    in the provision;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of section 148 or 249; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the supply of the trade-in, or the supply by way
    of sale referred to in paragraph (4.1)(a), as the case may be, is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a zero-rated supply,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a supply made outside Canada, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a supply in respect of which no tax is payable
      because of subsection 156(2) or paragraph 167(1.1)(a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exchange of natural gas liquids for
  make-up gas

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} natural gas is transported by pipeline to a
    straddle plant at which natural gas liquids or ethane (each of which
    is, in this subsection, referred to as "natural gas liquids") is
    recovered from the natural gas,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the residue gas is returned to the pipeline after
    the recovery along with other natural gas (in this subsection
    referred to as "make-up gas") that is supplied solely to make up for
    the loss of energy content due to the recovery, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the consideration or a part of the consideration
    for any supply of the natural gas liquids (or the right to recover
    the liquids) or any supply of the make-up gas is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a supply of the natural gas
      liquids or the right to recover the liquids, the make-up gas, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a supply of the make-up gas, the
      natural gas liquids or the right to recover the liquids,

  the value of that consideration or part, as the case may be, is deemed
  to be nil.

Meaning of [[provincial levy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

- **[[154]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-154 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this section, [[provincial levy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a tax,
  duty or fee imposed under an Act of the legislature of a province in
  respect of the supply, consumption or use of property or a service.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Levies included in consideration

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, the consideration for
  a supply of property or a service includes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any tax, duty or fee imposed under an Act of
    Parliament that is payable by the recipient, or payable or
    collectible by the supplier, in respect of that supply or in respect
    of the production, importation, consumption or use of the property
    or service, other than tax under this Part that is payable by the
    recipient;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any provincial levy that is payable by the
    recipient, or payable or collectible by the supplier, in respect of
    that supply or in respect of the consumption or use of the property
    or service, other than a prescribed provincial levy that is payable
    by the recipient; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any other amount that is collectible by the
    supplier under an Act of the legislature of a province and that is
    equal to, or is collectible on account of or in lieu of, a
    provincial levy, except where the amount is payable by the recipient
    and the provincial levy is a prescribed provincial levy.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reference to "recipient"

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If, under this Part, a person is deemed to be the
  recipient of a supply in respect of which another person would, but
  for that deeming, be the recipient, a reference in this section to the
  recipient of the supply shall be read as a reference to that other
  person.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-arm's length supplies

- **[[155]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-155 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purposes of this Part, where a supply of property or a service is
  made between persons not dealing with each other at arm's length for
  no consideration or for consideration less than the fair market value
  of the property or service at the time the supply is made, and the
  recipient of the supply is not a registrant who is acquiring the
  property or service for consumption, use or supply exclusively in the
  course of commercial activities of the recipient,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if no consideration is paid for the supply, the
    supply shall be deemed to be made for consideration, paid at that
    time, of a value equal to the fair market value of the property or
    service at that time; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if consideration is paid for the supply, the value
    of the consideration shall be deemed to be equal to the fair market
    value of the property or service at that time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a supply of property
  or a service by a person where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an amount is deemed under section 173 to be the
    total consideration for the supply; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the absence of subsection (1),

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the person, because of subsection 170(1), would
      not be entitled to claim an input tax credit in respect of the
      acquisition or importation of the property or service by the
      person,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subsection 172(2) would apply to the supply, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the supply would be an exempt supply included
      in Part V.1 or VI of Schedule V.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[156]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-156 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  definitions in this subsection apply in this section.

  [[Canadian partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Canadian partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2024, c.
      15, s. 133\]]{.Repealed}

  [[distribution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[distribution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned by
      subsection 55(1) of the [Income Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3). ([attribution]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[qualifying group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[qualifying group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a group of corporations, each member of which
        is closely related, within the meaning assigned by section 128,
        to each other member of the group; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a group of specified partnerships, or of
        specified partnerships and corporations, each member of which is
        closely related, within the meaning of this section, to each
        other member of the group. ([groupe admissible]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[qualifying member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[qualifying member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a qualifying group
      means a registrant that is a corporation resident in Canada or a
      specified partnership, each member of which is resident in Canada,
      and that meets the following conditions:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the registrant is a member of the group;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the registrant is not a party to an election
        under subsection 150(1); and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} one of the following conditions is met:

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the registrant has property (other than
          financial instruments and property having a nominal value) and
          has last manufactured, produced, acquired or imported all or
          substantially all of its property (other than financial
          instruments and property having a nominal value) for
          consumption, use or supply exclusively in the course of
          commercial activities of the registrant,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the registrant has no property (other than
          financial instruments and property having a nominal value) and
          has made supplies and all or substantially all of the supplies
          made by the registrant are taxable supplies, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the registrant has no property (other than
          financial instruments and property having a nominal value) and
          has not made taxable supplies and it is reasonable to expect
          that

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the registrant will be making supplies
            throughout the next 12 months,

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} all or substantially all of those supplies
            will be taxable supplies, and

          - [(C)]{.lawlabel} all or substantially all of the property
            (other than financial instruments and property having a
            nominal value) to be manufactured, produced, acquired or
            imported by the registrant within the next 12 months will be
            for consumption, use or supply exclusively in the course of
            commercial activities of the registrant. ([membre
            admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[secured creditor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[secured creditor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2000, c.
      30, s. 25\]]{.Repealed}

  [[security interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[security interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2000, c.
      30, s. 25\]]{.Repealed}

  [[specified member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a qualifying group
      means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a qualifying member of the group; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a temporary member of the group during the
        course of the reorganization referred to in paragraph (f) of the
        definition [[temporary member]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}. ([membre
        déterminé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specified partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a partnership
      each member of which is a corporation or a partnership. ([société
      de personnes déterminée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[temporary member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[temporary member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of a qualifying group
      means a particular corporation

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is a registrant;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is resident in Canada;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that is a member of the qualifying group;

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} that is not a qualifying member of the
        qualifying group;

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} that is not a party to an election under
        subsection 150(1);

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} that receives a supply of property that meets
        the following conditions:

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the supply is made by another corporation
          that is a qualifying member of the qualifying group and in
          contemplation of a distribution made in the course of a
          reorganization whereby the shares of the particular
          corporation are to be transferred upon the distribution to one
          or more corporations (in this definition referred to as the
          "transferee corporations"),

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the supplied property includes property that
          is neither a financial instrument nor property having a
          nominal value, and

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} all or substantially all of the supplied
          property (other than financial instruments and property having
          a nominal value)

          - [(A)]{.lawlabel} was last manufactured, produced, acquired
            or imported by the other corporation for consumption, use or
            supply exclusively in the course of the commercial
            activities of the other corporation,

          - [(B)]{.lawlabel} is not consumed, used or supplied by the
            particular corporation otherwise than exclusively in the
            course of its commercial activities, and

          - [(C)]{.lawlabel} may reasonably be expected to be consumed,
            used or supplied by the transferee corporations exclusively
            in the course of their commercial activities within 12
            months after the time the supply is made;

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} that, before receiving the supply, does not
        carry on any business or have any property (other than financial
        instruments); and

      - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the shares of which are transferred to the
        transferee corporations upon the distribution referred to in
        subparagraph (f)(i). ([membre temporaire]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Closely related persons

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, a particular
  specified partnership and another person that is a specified
  partnership or a corporation are closely related to each other at any
  time if, at that time,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case where the other person is a specified
    partnership,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} all or substantially all of the interest in the
      other person is held by

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the particular partnership,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} a corporation, or a specified partnership, that
        is a member of a qualifying group of which the particular
        partnership is a member, or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} any combination of corporations or partnerships
        referred to in clauses (A) and (B), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the particular partnership

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} both holds qualifying voting control in respect
        of a corporation that is a member of a qualifying group of which
        the other person is a member and owns at least 90% of the value
        and number of the issued and outstanding shares, having full
        voting rights under all circumstances, of the capital stock of
        the corporation, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} holds all or substantially all of the interest
        in a specified partnership that is a member of a qualifying
        group of which the other person is a member; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case where the other person is a
    corporation,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} qualifying voting control in respect of the other
      person is held by, and not less than 90% of the value and number
      of the issued and outstanding shares, having full voting rights
      under all circumstances, of the capital stock of the other person
      are owned by,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the particular partnership,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} a corporation, or a specified partnership, that
        is a member of a qualifying group of which the particular
        partnership is a member, or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} any combination of corporations or partnerships
        referred to in clauses (A) and (B),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} qualifying voting control in respect of a
      corporation is held by, and not less than 90% of the value and
      number of the issued and outstanding shares, having full voting
      rights under all circumstances, of the capital stock of the
      corporation are owned by,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} if the corporation is a member of a qualifying
        group of which the particular partnership is a member, the other
        person, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} if the corporation is a member of a qualifying
        group of which the other person is a member, the particular
        partnership,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} all or substantially all of the interest in the
      particular partnership is held by

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the other person,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} a corporation, or a specified partnership, that
        is a member of a qualifying group of which the other person is a
        member, or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} any combination of corporations or partnerships
        referred to in clauses (A) and (B), or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} all or substantially all of the interest in a
      specified partnership is held by

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} if the specified partnership is a member of a
        qualifying group of which the particular partnership is a
        member, the other person, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} if the specified partnership is a member of a
        qualifying group of which the other person is a member, the
        particular partnership.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Persons closely related to the same
  person

  [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} If, under subsection (1.1), two persons are closely
  related to the same corporation or specified partnership, the two
  persons are closely related to each other for the purposes of this
  section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interest in a partnership

  [(1.3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, a person, or a
  group of persons, holds, at any time, all or substantially all of the
  interest in a partnership only if, at that time,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person, or every person in the group of
    persons, is a member of the partnership; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person, or the members of the group
    collectively, as the case may be, is or are

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} entitled to receive at least 90% of

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} if the partnership had income for the last
        fiscal period (within the meaning of the [Income Tax
        Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3)) of the partnership that ended before that
        time (or, if the partnership's first fiscal period includes that
        time, for that period), the total of all amounts each of which
        is the share of that income from all sources that each member of
        the partnership is entitled to receive, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} if the partnership had no income for the last
        fiscal period or the first fiscal period referred to in clause
        (A), as the case may be, the total of all amounts each of which
        is the share of the income of the partnership that each member
        of the partnership would be entitled to receive if the income of
        the partnership from each source were one dollar,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} entitled to receive at least 90% of the total
      amount that would be paid to all members of the partnership
      (otherwise than as a share of any income of the partnership) if it
      were wound up at that time, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} able to direct the business and affairs of the
      partnership or would be so able if no secured creditor had any
      security interest in an interest in, or the property of, the
      partnership.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Election for nil consideration

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, if at any time after
  2014 a person that is a specified member of a qualifying group files
  an election made jointly by the person and another specified member of
  the group, every taxable supply made between the person and the other
  specified member at a time when the election is in effect is deemed to
  have been made for no consideration.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Elections filed before 2015

  [(2.01)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, if an election
  made under this section has been filed by any person before January 1,
  2015, the election is deemed never to have been filed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a supply by way of sale of real property;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a supply of property, or of a service, that is not
    acquired by the recipient for consumption, use or supply exclusively
    in the course of commercial activities of the recipient; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a supply that is not a supply of property that
    meets the conditions set out in paragraph (f) of the definition
    [[temporary member]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection (1), if the
    recipient of the supply is a temporary member.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cessation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An election under subsection (2) made jointly by a
  particular member of a qualifying group and another member of the
  group ceases to have effect on the earliest of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the day on which the particular member ceases to be
    a specified member of the group,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the day on which the other member ceases to be a
    specified member of the group, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the day on which the election is revoked jointly by
    those members.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Form of election and revocation

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} An election under subsection (2) made jointly by a
  particular specified member of a qualifying group and another
  specified member of the group and a revocation of the election by
  those specified members shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be made in prescribed form containing prescribed
    information and specify the day (in this subsection referred to as
    the "effective day") on which the election or revocation is to
    become effective; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be filed with the Minister in prescribed manner on
    or before

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the particular day that is the earlier of

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the day on or before which the particular
        specified member must file a return under Division V for the
        reporting period of the particular specified member that
        includes the effective day, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the day on or before which the other specified
        member must file a return under Division V for the reporting
        period of the other specified member that includes the effective
        day, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any day after the particular day that the
      Minister may allow.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Joint and several liability

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A particular person and another person are jointly
  and severally, or solidarily, liable for all obligations under this
  Part that result upon, or as a consequence of, a failure to account
  for or pay as and when required under this Part an amount of net tax
  of the particular person or of the other person if that tax is
  attributable to a supply made at any time between the particular
  person and the other person and if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an election under subsection (2) made jointly by
    the particular person and the other person

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is in effect at that time, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} ceased to be in effect before that time but the
      particular person and the other person are conducting themselves
      as if the election were in effect at that time; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the particular person and the other person purport
    to have jointly made an election under subsection (2) before that
    time and are conducting themselves as if an election under
    subsection (2) made jointly by the particular person and the other
    person were in effect at that time.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Meaning of [[selected qualifying
employer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

- **[[157]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-157 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purposes of this section, [[selected qualifying
  employer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning assigned by subsection
  172.1(9).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Election for nil consideration

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, if a participating
  employer of a pension plan elects jointly with a pension entity of the
  pension plan, every taxable supply made by the participating employer
  to the pension entity at a time when the election is in effect is
  deemed to have been made for no consideration.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Election for nil consideration ---
  master pension entity

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} A person that is a participating employer of a
  pension plan and a master pension entity of the pension plan may
  jointly make an election in respect of taxable supplies made by the
  person to the master pension entity if

  ::: {#190501 .Subsection}
  A ≥ 90%

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the total of all percentages, each of which is a master pension
      factor in respect of a pension plan of which the person is a
      participating employer for the fiscal year of the master pension
      entity that includes the day on which the election becomes
      effective.
  :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of subsection (2.1) election

  [(2.2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, every taxable supply
  made by a participating employer to a master pension entity at a time
  when a joint election made under subsection (2.1) by the participating
  employer and the master pension entity is in effect is deemed to have
  been made for no consideration.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a supply deemed under section 172.1 to have been
    made;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a supply of property or a service that is not
    acquired by a pension entity of a pension plan for consumption, use
    or supply by the pension entity in the course of pension activities
    (as defined in subsection 172.1(1)) in respect of the pension plan;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a supply made by a participating employer of a
    pension plan to a pension entity of the pension plan of all or part
    of property or a service if, at the time the participating employer
    acquires the property or service, the participating employer is a
    selected qualifying employer of the pension plan;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a supply made by a participating employer of a
    pension plan to a pension entity of the pension plan of property or
    a service if, at the time the participating employer consumes or
    uses an employer resource (as defined in subsection 172.1(1)) of the
    participating employer for the purpose of making the supply, the
    participating employer is a selected qualifying employer of the
    pension plan; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a supply made in prescribed circumstances or made
    by a prescribed person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application of subsection (2.2)

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2.2) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a supply deemed under section 172.1 to have been
    made;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a supply of property or a service that is not
    acquired by a master pension entity of a pension plan for
    consumption, use or supply by the master pension entity in the
    course of pension activities (as defined in subsection 172.1(1)) in
    respect of the pension plan;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a supply made by a participating employer of a
    pension plan to a master pension entity of the pension plan of all
    or part of property or a service if, at the time the participating
    employer acquires the property or service, the master pension entity
    is a master pension entity of one or more pension plans of which the
    participating employer is a selected qualifying employer;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a supply made by a participating employer of a
    pension plan to a master pension entity of the pension plan of
    property or a service if, at the time the participating employer
    consumes or uses an [[employer resource]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} (as
    defined in subsection 172.1(1)) of the participating employer for
    the purpose of making the supply, the master pension entity is a
    master pension entity of one or more pension plans of which the
    participating employer is a selected qualifying employer; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a supply made in prescribed circumstances or made
    by a prescribed person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Joint revocation

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The persons that have jointly made an election under
  subsection (2) or (2.1) may jointly revoke the election.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Form of election and revocation

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} An election under subsection (2) or (2.1) and a
  revocation of an election under subsection (4) must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be made in prescribed form containing prescribed
    information;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} specify the day on which the election or the
    revocation is to become effective, which must be the first day of a
    fiscal year of the participating employer; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be filed by the participating employer with the
    Minister in prescribed manner on or before the day that is the day
    on which the election or the revocation is to become effective or
    any later day that the Minister may allow.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cessation

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} An election made jointly under subsection (2) or
  (2.1) by a person that is a participating employer of a pension plan
  and by another person that is a pension entity of the pension plan or
  a master pension entity of the pension plan ceases to have effect on
  the earliest of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the day on which the person ceases to be a
    participating employer of the pension plan,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the day on which the other person ceases to be a
    pension entity of the pension plan or a master pension entity of the
    pension plan, as the case may be,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the day on which a joint revocation of the election
    under subsection (4) becomes effective,

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the day specified in a notice of revocation of the
    election sent to the person under subsection (9), and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an election under subsection (2.1),
    the first day of a fiscal year of the other person for which

    ::: {#190534 .Paragraph}
    A \< 90%

    where

    [A]{.dfn}
    :   is the total of all percentages, each of which is a master
        pension factor in respect of a pension plan of which the person
        is a participating employer for the fiscal year.
    :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of intent

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} If an election made jointly under subsection (2) or
  (2.1) by a participating employer of a pension plan and by a pension
  entity of the pension plan or a master pension entity of the pension
  plan is in effect at any time in a fiscal year of the participating
  employer and if the participating employer fails to account for, as
  and when required under this Part, any tax deemed to have been
  collected by the participating employer on the last day of the fiscal
  year under any of subsections 172.1(5) to (6.1) in respect of the
  pension plan, the Minister may send a notice in writing (in this
  section referred to as a "notice of intent") to the participating
  employer and to the pension entity or the master pension entity, as
  the case may be, that the Minister proposes to revoke the election as
  of the first day of the fiscal year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Representations to Minister

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} Upon receipt of a notice of intent, a participating
  employer must establish to the satisfaction of the Minister that the
  participating employer did not fail to account for, as and when
  required under this Part, tax deemed to have been collected by the
  participating employer under any of subsections 172.1(5) to (6.1) in
  respect of the pension plan.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of revocation

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} If, after 60 days after the day on which the notice
  of intent was sent by the Minister to the participating employer, the
  Minister is not satisfied that the participating employer did not fail
  to account for, as and when required under this Part, tax deemed to
  have been collected by the participating employer on the last day of a
  particular fiscal year under any of subsections 172.1(5) to (6.1) in
  respect of the pension plan, the Minister may send a notice in writing
  (in this section referred to as a "notice of revocation") to the
  participating employer and to the pension entity or master pension
  entity with which the participating employer made the election that
  the election is revoked as of the day specified in the notice of
  revocation, and that day is not to be earlier than the day specified
  in the notice of intent and must be the first day of any particular
  fiscal year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revocation --- effect

  [(10)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, an election under
  subsection (2) or (2.1) that has been revoked by the Minister under
  subsection (9) is deemed never to have been in effect on any day on or
  after the day specified in the notice of revocation.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Tax refund discounts

**[[158]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-158 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
this Part, where a discounter (within the meaning of the [Tax Rebate
Discounting Act](/eng/acts/T-3)) pays an amount to a person to acquire
from the person a right to a refund of tax (within the meaning of that
Act), notwithstanding section 139, the discounter shall be deemed to
have made

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a taxable supply of a service for consideration equal
  to the lesser of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} 2/3 of the amount, if any, by which the amount of
    the refund exceeds the amount paid by the discounter to the person
    to acquire the right, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} \$30; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a separate supply of a financial service for
  consideration equal to the amount by which the amount of the refund
  exceeds the total of the amount paid by the discounter to the person
  to acquire the right and the amount determined under paragraph (a).

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 1990, c. 45, s. 12
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Value in Canadian currency

**[[159]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-159 .sectionLabel}** Where the consideration
for a supply is expressed in a foreign currency, the value of the
consideration shall, for the purposes of this Part, be computed on the
basis of the value of that foreign currency in Canadian currency on the
day the tax is payable, or on such other day as is acceptable to the
Minister.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 1990, c. 45, s. 12
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Coin-operated devices

**[[160]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-160 .sectionLabel}** Where a supply is made,
and the consideration therefor is paid, by means of a coin-operated
device, the following rules apply for the purposes of this Part:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the recipient shall be deemed to have

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} received the supply,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} paid the consideration for the supply, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} paid any tax payable in respect of the supply,

  on the day the consideration for the supply is inserted into the
  device; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the supplier shall be deemed to have

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} made the supply,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} received the consideration for the supply, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} collected any tax payable in respect of the
    supply,

  on the day the consideration for the supply is removed from the
  device.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 1990, c. 45, s. 12
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Early or late payments

**[[161]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-161 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
this Part, where tangible personal property or services are supplied and
the amount of consideration for the supply shown in the invoice in
respect of the supply may be reduced if the amount thereof is paid
within a time specified in the invoice or an additional amount is
charged to the recipient by the supplier if the amount of the
consideration is not paid within a reasonable period specified in the
invoice, the consideration due shall be deemed to be the amount of
consideration shown in the invoice.

::: HistoricalNote
- \[NOTE: Application provisions are not included in the consolidated
  text
- see relevant amending Acts and regulations.\]
- 1990, c. 45, s. 12
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[162]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-162 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  definitions in this subsection apply in this section.

  [[estimated reserves]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[estimated reserves]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} of minerals means the
      estimated quantities of minerals that geological and engineering
      data demonstrate, with reasonable certainty, to be recoverable
      under existing economic and operating conditions. ([réserves
      estimées]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[farm-out agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[farm-out agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an agreement
      referred to in subsection (4). ([accord
      d'amodiation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[natural resource right]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[natural resource right]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a right to explore for or exploit a mineral
        deposit;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a right of entry or user relating to a right
        referred to in paragraph (a); or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a right to an amount computed by reference to
        the production (including profit) from, or to the value of
        production from, a mineral deposit. ([droit relatif à des
        ressources]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specified mining or well-site equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified mining or well-site equipment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},
      in relation to the exploration or development of unproven property
      under a farm-out agreement, means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} equipment, installations and structures for use
        at a mine site in the production of minerals from the mine and
        not in the milling, smelting, refining or other processing of
        the minerals after production; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} equipment, installations and structures for use
        at a well site in the production of minerals from the well,
        including a heater, dehydrator or other well-site facility for
        the initial treatment of substances produced from the well to
        prepare such production for transportation but excluding

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any equipment, installation, structure or
          facility that serves or is intended to serve a well that has
          not been drilled in the course of the exploration or
          development under that agreement, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any equipment, installation, structure or
          facility for use in the refining of oil or the processing of
          natural gas including the separation therefrom of liquid
          hydrocarbons, sulphur or other joint products or
          by-products. ([matériel déterminé]{.DefinedTermLink
          lang="fr"})

  [[unproven property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[unproven property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means real property for
      which estimated reserves of minerals have not been
      attributed. ([bien non prouvé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Natural resources

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, the supply of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a right to explore for or exploit a mineral
    deposit, a peat bog or deposit of peat or a forestry, water or
    fishery resource,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a right of entry or user relating to a right
    referred to in paragraph (a),

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a right to an amount computed by reference to the
    production (including profit) from, or to the value of production
    from, any such deposit, bog or resource, or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a right to enter or use land to generate, or
    evaluate the feasibility of generating, electricity from the sun or
    wind,

  shall be deemed not to be a supply and any consideration paid or due,
  or any fee or royalty charged or reserved, in respect of the right
  shall be deemed not to be consideration for the right.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to a supply of a right
  to take or remove forestry products, products that grow in water,
  fishery products, minerals or peat, a right of entry or user relating
  thereto or a right referred to in paragraph (2)(d), if the supply is
  made to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a consumer; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a person who is not a registrant and who acquires
    the right in the course of a business of the person of making
    supplies of the products, minerals, peat or electricity to
    consumers.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exploration and development of mineral
  deposits

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, if, under an agreement
  in writing between a person (in this subsection referred to as the
  "farmor") and another person (in this subsection referred to as the
  "farmee"), the farmor transfers to the farmee particular natural
  resource rights, or portions of them, relating to unproven property in
  consideration or part consideration for the farmee undertaking the
  exploration of the property for mineral deposits, providing
  information (or the right to it) gathered from the exploration and,
  subject to any conditions that may be provided in the agreement,
  developing the property for the production of minerals,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the value, as consideration, of any property or
    service given by the farmor to the farmee under the agreement is
    deemed to be nil to the extent that the property or service is given
    as consideration for any of the following (each of which is referred
    to in this subsection as the "farmee's contribution"):

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the undertaking of that exploration or
      development,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the provision of that information (or the right
      to it), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any transfer under the agreement by the farmee
      to the farmor of any interest in specified mining or well-site
      equipment that is used by the farmee exclusively in that
      exploration or development;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the value of the farmee's contribution as
    consideration for any property or service given by the farmor to the
    farmee under the agreement is deemed to be nil; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if part of the consideration given by the farmor
    for the farmee's contribution is a service or property (each of
    which is referred to in this paragraph as the "farmor's additional
    contribution") that is not a natural resource right relating to
    unproven property,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the farmee is deemed to have made, at the place
      at which the unproven property is situated, a taxable supply of a
      service to the farmor separate from any supply by the farmee under
      the agreement and that service is deemed to be consideration for
      the farmor's additional contribution,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the value of that service and the value of the
      farmor's additional contribution as consideration for the supply
      of that service are each deemed to be equal to the fair market
      value of the farmor's additional contribution determined at the
      time (in this paragraph referred to as the "time of transfer")
      that

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} if the farmor's additional contribution is a
        service, performance of the service commences, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, ownership of the farmor's
        additional contribution is transferred to the farmee,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} all of the consideration for the farmor's
      additional contribution and the consideration for the service
      deemed to have been supplied by the farmee are deemed to become
      due at the time of transfer, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} if, in addition to the farmee's contribution,
      the farmee supplies to the farmor other property or services
      (other than the service deemed under subparagraph (i) to have been
      supplied) for which part of the consideration is the farmor's
      additional contribution, the value of the consideration for the
      supply of the other property or services is deemed to be equal to
      the amount, if any, by which the value of that consideration,
      determined without reference to this subparagraph, exceeds the
      fair market value of the farmor's additional contribution.
